body:
Every suppressive action these vengeful partisans take shows their true colors. For all their talk about election integrity, voter ID, and not harming eligible voters, closing legitimate polling places to make it harder to vote only has one logical end result.
Attacks by opponents of voting rights on young voters, mail-in ballots, early voting, and more aren't about integrity and fairness. It's about protecting their own power at any cost and tilting the playing field before the game has even been played.
We must stand up to stop them at every turn. RUSH $35 or more today to help us fight back in North Carolina and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042726_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042726_3&amount=25]
We're now facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to help every eligible voter cast their ballot >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042726_3&amount=35]

These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.
Opponents of voting rights aren't going to stop attacking our fundamental right to vote until we stop them at the ballot box and take away their power. Chip in $35 or whatever you can today to help fight back nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042726_3&amount=35]

Friend, Our elections are in serious jeopardy. The SAVE Act is vital to the sanctity of our future elections. We all remember the insanity of the 2020 election in Michigan:
* The late-night ballot drops.
* The blacked-out windows in Detroit vote-counting rooms.
* Qualified Republican poll watchers denied entry—left standing out in the cold.

**Michigan is Ground Zero for election reform efforts.** But there’s a massive obstacle standing in the way. Democrat Jocelyn Benson is running for Governor. **As Secretary of State, Jocelyn Benson oversaw the chaos and confusion.**
* She pushed same-day voter registration and unrestricted absentee voting.
* She mailed out 7.7 million unsolicited absentee ballot applications.
* She even instructed election workers to “presume” signatures were valid—without meaningful verification.

If we want **_TRUE_** election reform, Michigan needs a governor willing to act. And something tells me Jocelyn Benson won’t be overturning her own failed policies. As Governor, I will make election security a top priority so Michigan can have honest, fair elections again. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: New York Times: "People are going silent"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4589?t=1&akid=2186%2E5691347%2EcqaATi)

Peter,
Before I ran for the U.S. Senate, I was an investigative journalist leading a team that exposed corruption and human rights abuses worldwide.
This report in _The New York Times_ reminded me of what I saw in many of those investigations:
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260427-2-f&t=2&akid=2186%2E5691347%2EcqaATi)
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation.
From the article:
_Fired federal workers who are worried about losing their homes ask not to be quoted by name. University presidents fearing that millions of dollars in federal funding could disappear are holding their fire. Chief executives alarmed by tariffs that could hurt their businesses are on mute. ..._
_“When you see important societal actors — be it university presidents, media outlets, C.E.O.s, mayors, governors — changing their behavior in order to avoid the wrath of the government, that’s a sign that we’ve crossed the line into some form of authoritarianism,” said Steven Levitsky, a professor of government at Harvard and the co-author of the influential 2018 book “How Democracies Die.”_
**This is unacceptable in the United States of America.**
Peter — As Trump dismantles checks on his power and purges the government to fill every office with loyalists, more and more Americans are too afraid of retaliation to speak up.
**This descent into an un-American America must be stopped. We must regain Congressional power.**
I’m the ONLY Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won.
That means I’m MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
**Help me beat them again, just like we did in 2021.**
[**Please contribute to my campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260427-2-f&t=3&akid=2186%2E5691347%2EcqaATi)
Thank you for chipping in if you can.
\- Jon

name: AOC
subject: A foolish mistake
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
These priorities are actually not partisan at all.
#
Republicans are making a foolish mistake by saying they think that making investments in housing and energy are so-called 'Democrat priorities.'
Cutting the EPA as a 'Democrat priority.' Do you know what this country looked like before the EPA?
Rivers in rural areas were _on fire_ because of corporations poisoning the people who lived in those areas. Poor, middle-class communities getting poisoned and dumped on by corporations — like DuPont and 3M — pouring chemicals into these places.
Well, you know what?
**You're damn well right that it's a Democratic priority to keep people from getting poisoned** by identifying dangerous chemicals that are being dumped and causing cancer in people without their knowledge.
**You're damn right that it's a Democratic priority to bring down the cost of housing** , and mortgages, and rent.
**And you're damn right that it's a Democratic priority to raise the minimum wage in this country** to allow people to get a fair shot at the American dream.
If they want to say that's a 'Democratic priority' — they're right.
But it's important for us to remember that _these priorities are actually not partisan at all_.
They think they're hurting Democrats — but what they are doing is choosing to hurt _Americans_.
We cannot allow it. Our movement will have to push back harder than ever.
[Stand with us in the fight by making a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260427-2.ksAlU6&refcode=em20260427-11278-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11278%2E2526796%2Eo-Fgga)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: JB Pritzker
subject: We can’t take our eye off the ball
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
It’s JB Pritzker, and I’m worried.
There’s a lot of talk about Democrats winning the Senate, but there is NO path to victory without New Hampshire, and Chris Pappas needs our support. **[Will you chip in to support his battleground Senate campaign today?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260427_3.0DkqOt&refcode=em20260427-3&t=1&akid=6358%2E582294%2EOkG0XD)**
New Hampshire has _always_ been a purple state, and national Republicans see it as one of their BEST pick-up opportunities to cement their Senate majority for years to come. Democrats can’t take their eyes off the ball because **this is by no means a safe blue seat.**
We have a real shot at securing a Democratic Senate majority in November, but any path to victory runs through New Hampshire.
Our country’s next chapter could be determined by what happens in the Granite State this fall. That’s why I hope you’ll support Chris Pappas. He’s a proven fighter for working families, he’s taken on Big Pharma, and he’s fighting to make sure the government actually works for the people it serves.
The GOP knows that New Hampshire is their best shot to flip a blue seat. Donald Trump, corporate PACs, and the national GOP are already spending _big_ to make that happen. The only way we can beat them is with grassroots support — so I need you with me.
**[If you’re able, please chip in $5 or more to Chris Pappas right now. Winning in New Hampshire is the only path to a Democratic Senate majority.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260427_3.0DkqOt&refcode=em20260427-3&t=2&akid=6358%2E582294%2EOkG0XD)**

---
| | | Last Tuesday, 4/21, Virginians voted yes to change the Congressional district maps. On the day after the election, a circuit court judge in Tazewell County, Virginia, blocked the vote. That judge ruled in favor of the RNC and prevented the certification of the election results. In fact, this marked the third time the same Tazewell County Circuit Judge challenged redistricting.

So we have a “no” from one circuit court.
Separately, the City of Richmond Circuit Court weighed in on the fairness of the redistricted maps and ruled against the RNC. They held that the General Assembly had the power to pass legislation creating the “10-1” map. The court declined to overturn the will of the voters.
Then we had a “yes” from another circuit court, effectively creating a circuit split.
Yesterday, April 27, the Virginia Supreme Court heard oral arguments from both sides on the amendment, and now all we can do is wait. Once the court has made a final decision, Ericka will release a statement to the press.

| The hydration advice you've heard all your life is outdated. Let me explain why. | | "Drink 8 glasses of water a day." We've all heard this advice. But what if you drink your 8 glasses and STILL feel dehydrated? Here's the reason: After age 60, your body goes through 3 big changes. Chances are your doctor hasn't explained these changes to you. These changes affect how you keep water in your body, distribute it, and use it. In short, they make it hard to stay hydrated, no matter how much water you drink. That's why people over 60 often feel dry mouth, fatigue, and brain fog - even when doing everything "right." The good news is that [scientists found a simple fix.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NjB9AAwAAAAAAEy7gLV5ecjaUaBAHudUkRgXQvWtWJrPypyFb_mFkIEjCLCLNieQ7ziRaAI_31JikSVw7tDo7qsP0Rs4XcBDUa0DKTatlgzWFUlOX0Aw2g) Folks who try it feel more awake in 30 minutes. They have steady energy all day. And their focus returns. The most surprising part? They drink LESS water but stay MORE hydrated. I know that sounds impossible. But once you see the science, it makes perfect sense. [Here's more about the 3 body changes sabotaging your hydration (and the simple fix)](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NjB9AAwAAAAAAEy7gLV68LGm_wDugoDAiH2XYbkiJ-uxnF8dfqDKo3YZ4fPhoqk2ZvFQ2clFkaOOYLFAb0b1_e7ZnXgB0M5jPXqlYobvuYd1pT7gf4Pgkw) To Your Best Health, Dr. Greg Eckel |

name: James O'Keefe
subject: The White House responded to our hidden camera election fraud footage.
body:
A man handed a homeless person a post-it note and a dollar bill on a sidewalk in Los Angeles. On the note was a name, an address, and a date of birth

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zntt876e0ks5732nqf7fh8cuc0339dnllbv10bu0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")

---
| Dear Patriot,
A man handed a homeless person a post-it note and a dollar bill on a sidewalk in Los Angeles. On the note was a name, an address, and a date of birth — **a real voter's identity.** “Sign his name,” the man said. “Just write what I tell you to write.”**[**We filmed the whole thing.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zl25sl7ah7ea84dgb54peodjmori0hrrqdj38nlo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs)

**[****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2za7ccr9h58dho2qnir25vo5ajrrkc00a012e25r0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs)What you're about to see is the most explosive hidden-camera footage my team has ever captured. Not speculation. Not anonymous sources.**Actual election crimes committed on camera — in broad daylight — on the streets of Los Angeles.** Over the course of several days, my undercover journalists documented petition circulators handing post-it notes with real voters' names and addresses to homeless individuals, paying them cash — one to three dollars per signature — and instructing them to forge those voters' signatures on official petitions and voter registration forms.We captured it **twenty-eight times.** That's twenty-eight documented instances in just a few days of filming. Which means across Los Angeles County, this is happening **tens of thousands of times.**[****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt73pa6ijt1dikaonb77hkq7df04og0ndjd1hmho_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")****| [▶ WATCH THE HIDDEN-CAMERA FOOTAGE AND CHIP IN $35](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zprun11lp16smqng5deqg3ggmh7ve47lcuct3a80_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")
---
Let me walk you through what our cameras caught.
A voter named Vicky Walker. A voter named Paulson. A voter named Joseph Albright. Real people. Real identities. In each case, a petition coordinator handed a homeless person a sticky note bearing that voter's information and told them to sign as if they were that person.
One coordinator was caught on camera admitting they get paid seven to ten dollars per signature. They're turning around and paying homeless people a fraction of that — a dollar, sometimes three — to commit federal crimes on their behalf.
Let me be clear about what we're talking about: **it is a federal crime to provide false information on a voter registration form. It is a federal crime to offer payment for voter registration.** What we documented is not a gray area. It is multiple felonies, exposed on hidden camera, happening systematically.
The New York Times told America this doesn't happen. Their Sunday edition dismissed election fraud concerns. **We just proved them wrong twenty-eight times on tape.**
And here's what happened next: we brought our footage to the White House. Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt called it “astounding.” NBC News covered it. The story is breaking through.
**But investigations like this are not free.**
Every dollar you give goes directly to fieldwork: $35 covers a day of undercover equipment costs. $50 covers the background research we do to identify real voters whose identities are being stolen. $100 funds a full day of field operations. $250 helps cover the legal costs of protecting our journalists when powerful people try to shut us down.
[****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn173e9li9tg6nb79bg0gdcv1bt9vsa4iv57nkb0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")****
[▶ CHIP IN $50 TO KEEP OUR CAMERAS ROLLING](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5buhfg2tg0fr0d7b8gg1dagjk6adv5rdillrhe8_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")
---
Think about what's at stake. If petition circulators can forge voter signatures by the tens of thousands in broad daylight — paying homeless people with cash and cigarettes to impersonate real voters — and the system does nothing about it, then your vote is being diluted. Your voice is being stolen.
The only reason we know about this is because my team was there with hidden cameras. **No one else was going to expose this.** Not the Times. Not local officials. Not the people getting paid seven dollars a signature to look the other way.
We did it. And we need your help to keep doing it.
Can I count on you today?
[****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbige08h9ddo3grcjk4q3gnnfikq6o6h7rm5i24g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjm0ob2c3h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=gopp&amount=25")****

---

In Truth,
James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

**P.S.** They said election fraud doesn't happen. We filmed it twenty-eight times in a matter of days — real voters' identities, forged by strangers for a dollar a signature. The White House has seen it. NBC has covered it. But the investigation isn't over. **Your gift of $35, $50, or $100 today puts our cameras back on the street tomorrow.**

body:
A man handed a homeless person a post-it note and a dollar bill on a sidewalk in Los Angeles. On the note was a name, an address, and a date of birth

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zud3ujomj853c3m0adoohmep30qgeg82pkcsvlpg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=aan&amount=25")

---
| Dear Patriot,
A man handed a homeless person a post-it note and a dollar bill on a sidewalk in Los Angeles. On the note was a name, an address, and a date of birth — **a real voter's identity.** “Sign his name,” the man said. “Just write what I tell you to write.”**[**We filmed the whole thing.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeeed7u4udls8m1fan9bcf06unolhpkcvqu9nmgg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs)

**[****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvlg0ughufu2vkp19rloc2mrg3qk6ccl7a9h1m78_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs)What you're about to see is the most explosive hidden-camera footage my team has ever captured. Not speculation. Not anonymous sources.**Actual election crimes committed on camera — in broad daylight — on the streets of Los Angeles.** Over the course of several days, my undercover journalists documented petition circulators handing post-it notes with real voters' names and addresses to homeless individuals, paying them cash — one to three dollars per signature — and instructing them to forge those voters' signatures on official petitions and voter registration forms.We captured it **twenty-eight times.** That's twenty-eight documented instances in just a few days of filming. Which means across Los Angeles County, this is happening **tens of thousands of times.**[****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z71uplfian2vef1hvhtji0jmahun304t7rqeo23o_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=aan&amount=25")****| [▶ WATCH THE HIDDEN-CAMERA FOOTAGE AND CHIP IN $35](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7jkvuj8ircntmngrlrm71und9pusrslmvi2004o_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=aan&amount=25")
---
Let me walk you through what our cameras caught.
A voter named Vicky Walker. A voter named Paulson. A voter named Joseph Albright. Real people. Real identities. In each case, a petition coordinator handed a homeless person a sticky note bearing that voter's information and told them to sign as if they were that person.
One coordinator was caught on camera admitting they get paid seven to ten dollars per signature. They're turning around and paying homeless people a fraction of that — a dollar, sometimes three — to commit federal crimes on their behalf.
Let me be clear about what we're talking about: **it is a federal crime to provide false information on a voter registration form. It is a federal crime to offer payment for voter registration.** What we documented is not a gray area. It is multiple felonies, exposed on hidden camera, happening systematically.
The New York Times told America this doesn't happen. Their Sunday edition dismissed election fraud concerns. **We just proved them wrong twenty-eight times on tape.**
And here's what happened next: we brought our footage to the White House. Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt called it “astounding.” NBC News covered it. The story is breaking through.
**But investigations like this are not free.**
Every dollar you give goes directly to fieldwork: $35 covers a day of undercover equipment costs. $50 covers the background research we do to identify real voters whose identities are being stolen. $100 funds a full day of field operations. $250 helps cover the legal costs of protecting our journalists when powerful people try to shut us down.

[▶ CHIP IN $50 TO KEEP OUR CAMERAS ROLLING](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2g65otfecbjng8blk32kiuggfb0vk2duhuk35mo_rp22sh2s8i6epr7cpjmeor1c5h2bs "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=aan&amount=25")
---
Think about what's at stake. If petition circulators can forge voter signatures by the tens of thousands in broad daylight — paying homeless people with cash and cigarettes to impersonate real voters — and the system does nothing about it, then your vote is being diluted. Your voice is being stolen.
The only reason we know about this is because my team was there with hidden cameras. **No one else was going to expose this.** Not the Times. Not local officials. Not the people getting paid seven dollars a signature to look the other way.
We did it. And we need your help to keep doing it.
Can I count on you today?

James O'Keefe

O'Keefe Media Group

## Dinner Attack Reignites Ballroom Push
Cole Allen, the 31-year-old suspected gunman in Saturday's White House Correspondents' Dinner attack, was charged Monday with [attempted assassination](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuhCAURb8Gd0zwgTIuWDRp3E03TdOlQXgqDfIMMDPx75vpL3R9k5tzzvdtutkQQ1o_7I6mLjQlfJaItWKeZhtjJtqPe9kilTqHOeJhV5xAQM-F4nCdvA3xnFTjzYIIKBs0rdZaaqEH0WzGy8W1YlbOQgcw9MJZN6NG6ZXqEIcmmNebUHBthehhuGjwwi69s52aFwnIlEAfKuXLD4VUN1ziSQ_MF0d7E81W61GYfGMwMhjt7F4Gr43B-PXJYHxuoSLf6F6QO8oZy0HJY6qF-5ASZl42ohrSysu9HOgqtznbsCb0fKfk7clgLJXyyeQYPJPvrQTVimvfNdn44xliDKXXTIl1tyH-gdV_1XwY-A0AAP__JQ2LcQ) of President Trump after running past a Secret Service magnetometer with a 12-gauge shotgun and handgun. An investigation found that guests entered the Washington Hilton by flashing tickets without ID checks or scans, and Allen checked into his room the day before to bypass perimeter security entirely. [See the investigation here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu3CAURVeDOywMjPEUFEl-3EQ_XZTSepiHzQgDAjzWZPXRZAupr3R1zvn9uXyCDz5uP-FA3VxaIl41YGtYFgMhlJSOfNY9pNqMNwEzbLhwxkfKJOXTYsGH1yI7qx0iR9GhHpRSQjF1Z92uLYfRiBEmNRiYbnAH4yQq4VYwqzRT5_X7jUk-DYyN_N4rbhm4cYWbNE5wJJKh9S2V_pF8bDu68EpPLP2aji7ovbVcifhC-Ez4fF1Xf9XHeyN8Pit9-xA-t3IemdY9pebjRtdUCtacosXYKrU-Riy04noW314UBzkJwW5EzLUR8ZF__Pn2_RfhIxyZiK9HskR8uOCzSVBsV7TNlw_B11ERybYDfPhH1_4r6VPzvwEAAP___CuNGw). The breach has renewed Trump's push for a $400 million White House ballroom. The Justice Department asked the National Trust for Historic Preservation to drop its lawsuit blocking construction, [but the Trust declined](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI7M4LVD4WIbumwTrbZENh7CrAxG9hCUv3_i_cIrr650dc_59xgfnhJtrz9-RcdzHjc8a0JmLGPwKZWc1_2oS8qVA4WEu3_hCAqMVFrCfYye0mfUTXQzImDXoGuttZ1VtlfN4qDHEEM0bTQ9ahXbXhs7hdCb-xxC0A25a01puLdKGehvFqLys5n8Lx3mDlBohZE4l9v_TBsvOKdPfmO5TXltkluY9yq63wIGAYMP00VwdQKGv08Bw0kFn5zLR8Cweaa8-SS5HJVlLHmX9SC-8rpXqZVa5bkQo1zyUVG2HWjoQOmmuLiflBJVY4VWr9VT-r7AP_L2dvAVAAD___uOgtk). Sen. University of Glasgow scholars have [recovered 42 lost pages](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuhDAQQNHTmG4tMxhsChdp6DZtSmswA3YyYATeRXv7aHOFXOBJ_3_d_R0Tp235xJVcmbPf6DqZSqHDj8h85LzujzNyPsuYRqYdF_KgoLspfQPrJ0z88rqa3EwE1FTkamNMY5TpVRVdH3Swxs5BByI7hr7TOmBrlTWaQttUyb01pcHWSnXQSwOTwrkL2OpxboCEVjSlkg_5ndNWIs38yk86ZMhrxS6Wsp-i-RAwCBiu65ILo8QgHz8ChneOgCESTpw28jV0DejW0yZjWbk63LRfiTmdnRFaLSsm_oPLv248HfwGAAD__zU8c4U) from Codex H, one of the most important early New Testament manuscripts. ## QB Seeks Treatment for Gambling Addiction
Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby is taking a [leave of absence](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupCAYRp9GOwwwKFhQbGM3225pQH6UDMIs_DuOb79xkntf4NYnOfm-8-c-302IIa2_zQ4a3z7PCY4aARHKvJrdXtA4FxYMOS0mubNueeaUD4QKwtXsTIjnLFqnLXUja0EzKeVNCiZZu-n-Zj3tR6N6Ow7eObFwRXuhOFDTi8G0QV8yKrhijHKhOi6lBzYw5Yex90w1goILmEuHGyC8TfXxzC8o3ZL3NuoN8Vmb26-GTw2fjuPofH5fLy7e8Cn_w0dYHqQ-c8Ha8OnjIAjLRv5aYgskZxKpuVR7EkgIJaSVYAGDOyQkXxnId4e2aPc8QoyhDrIRdN1NiJ85-LOIL83_BwAA__81jIm6) from the team to enter a residential treatment program for a gambling addiction, the university announced Monday. The NCAA is reportedly [investigating](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OtCAYha8GOwy8MqIFxdfYzdduafh5URIUA2Qc737jJLs3sPU5eXKe8_WcnzrEsC__9Yaqvn2adzxLxFoxz4vezB1q54KtIe1W7-4qa5qBQU-ZoDDMTod4zaJxyjA38gYVl1J2UnDJm1U57rqxYyDR2Qc8uhHHQQ7aG4mCS_BNUDeMCRg4ZyCGFqT0yHs--H58eD4QwdCFmnJbV6z41sXHK70wtzZtTVRrrUch3T8CE4HpPM_WmlKOlGu5GwQmm2LEBalPqRodI4HptiQwfXC0ol2pybg7vdOScjEX_XGnv_L0yGnJ-gY2WbnjDDGG0ksi2LLpED9z6t9OfCn4DgAA___Hl4i8) Sorsby for placing thousands of online bets since 2022, when he was a backup at Indiana. The organization prohibits student-athletes from betting on college and professional sports and recently banned dozens of players from competition for violations of the rule. Sorsby started for the Hoosiers in 2023 and played the next two years for Cincinnati before [signing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkM2upCAUhJ8Gdxj-FF2wmI27nu0szVEOSgahB0jbvv3ETu59gbv-UpWq789jfoAPPm6_4UBT3y7NEc8SsFbM8wbHckOw1q_Vp7hCtFfZ0yyY6ClTVAyzBR-uWTXWLMyOvEHDtdZSK655s5tulGMvEQfpJNoepWZjB6vqhJN8EbLx5i5jSgycM6GGVmjtkPd8cP3YOT4QxdD6mnJbd6z4huLClV6Y2zUdTTB7rc9C5C8iJiKm8zzbFOXNiJjuM0RMnxStuO7030KXjNFCpCXlsly0wl8fN-qPA62HijQgvJAmR2EpGFekLmX65YJ-yyBiarKxz9OH4EuviWLbAT58ZtWfyXwZ8T8AAP__aN2Kyw) with the Red Raiders this offseason for an NIL deal worth more than $5 million. University officials have not provided a treatment timeline for Sorsby and are asking for privacy. "_We love Brendan and support his decision to seek professional help_ ," Texas Tech head coach Joey McGuire [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb_G7hjBG8awBUUad5s2pfUwDxsJwwaexuu_j2ak5AdSH-nonvvrc_nElFPZfuJBjr9jXQqdPRMztWXDw78ghpBWTrWsWMLV97qAhElILcAuAVO-Fj0G52X4UCM5ZYy5G62MGndno9LwAPkAb-UkMci7fsiIMdwVSAtjci-Z1GCVkqDtDYyJpCZl4_TxiMoOWlJIXNuNd2L6xh7zVZ_Ubms9xux25q8-3H8MMA8wn-d56-mFBpjXmjNtJGKt7DHnAea3QDCtu_jthW9UAhbRa-v-ElSYWheNdvTib734ly_KiihSeVLntCFTF56YU9nG5sLXmXJOfTKDltuBKb_38f-9-nTwJwAA__9kZ47l) in a statement. "_Taking this step requires courage, and our primary focus is on him as a person. Our program is behind Brendan as he prioritizes his health_."
## El Paso Dam Collapse Averted
An El Paso dam at risk of collapse has been [stabilized](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGupDAQBNDTmKxHdo_BTOBgE7K_6YaojZvB-gYj24JhT79ir_DjJ5Wq6s_X-EUhhu39m1a29TOnceOzRK6V8_im1d1I3oephrRNtPmrLGlEiR1IDdiPnkK8Rt1466R_qYatMsY8jVZGNYttySO_UKFqn23XoXFI2imHjjs3k2yCvcOkxl4pibp_oDEzq071c_dqZ9ULLdmHmvKjLlz5Q2WOVzo4P6a0NtEute5FPH8JHAQO33P61OMmgcO9ReAQ00RR4MARdioJTqqcodBVYOKVtwqRvhk8rVAquRDDX_aQE_kCmdPOG1CBKfNZwGcKG2QunI8UcpOt388QYyidEVq-Vwrxf7H6szsPi_8CAAD__wF3jHQ) after the water level in a 39-million-gallon reservoir was lowered by 17 feet in recent days. El Paso Water purchased the 300-acre Cement Lake last month from the Texas Department of Transportation, but the reservoir's 117-year-old dam [wasn't inspected](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOrCAQx58GOwyMrLgFxWnsvtOe0owyKFkQA-zFtz9xX-HrJplf_rd_P9MP-uD39S9GMvXj0rTTuwSqlfK0YpyvJ1rrl-rTvuBuz7KlCQT0XCgOw2TRh3NSjTWzsHfZkJFa604rqWWzmXmeB2tnKZZFOqs7Ja3DuxAAHd3wNjfeXGJCwSClADW0oLUj2cvB9febkwNTgqyvKbd1o0ofLC6c6UW5XVJsgtlqPQrr_jAYGYwUDiwp4lWgtCmvDMbLgMEo1HWrL8Qvir-xUuYWI8--PPjzOCjzF4ZAJ18o0l55wAfx45mXDQsxGJts7PH2IfjSa6bEGtGHb5L6u_1eBv4HAAD__zlthMg) before the purchase, according to a spokesperson for the public utility. A database maintained by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers indicates the dam was last inspected in 1996. The utility began work on strengthening the dam after determining it was deficient, but that effort was [halted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGu4yAQgOHTQIcFY2xIQbGNu2y7pTWGcYyETQQoJLdf5V3h1b_0Ff-_-3rHmOL1-Isnufbe83pRr4lao7I-8Ny-EUOIvsV8ebzCpx55BQmzkFqAXQPG9Fk1D26T4aY4OWWMGY1WRvHDWS1RgZXgvZ52DXYLZjYKJknzNpnAo_tiUoNVSoK2Axizk5qV3efbtCvLtKQQWy5DO6jRG-uePvlFZfD55MkdrT0rG_8wWBgsvfcBc_o2BguWFn2iymChJJ5Ys-jYqIiO5aoiXr4QVgpCaq0kjOM0HO1MvLjw7DGlWGfDtHycGH9I3n436eXgfwAAAP__5rB6cg) Thursday when a breach appeared imminent. Crews resumed work Saturday, though the area remains closed to the public. "_We had a very close call with a near-dam collapse, but it has been stabilized, and the risk is now very low_ ," said John Balliew, president and CEO of El Paso Water. "_Our crews acted quickly and decisively to protect public safety and critical infrastructure_."
## Austin Icon Shuts Down
Lammes Candies, Austin's oldest continuously run family-owned business, is [shutting down](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDvO5CAQhE-DM1vAsIYJCDZxNptuaLVNYyPxGEF7HrdfsVf4o5a6SlX66u9jfUCIIR9_IKGljy9rxneLSIR1PSBtXQTnwk6h5B2y-7azrJLLeeRqlGZ1EOJ3VYOzG3d3MaAVWuubVkKL4bTKG2_AA6AxwD3fUUlwQnFUm4EbDMH2MK6kEYJLZSaptUcxC-Pn-y8vDFMcXaBSJzqR8APNx295YZ32koZoT6JnY7ffTC5MLnA1Cnnar0hXxQTP7mJy6VhMLhUbwVUhUxs3qP0VISVsY2cL_cbSQj6YXIZq3fMdYgxt1kzxI0GI_0vpZ1O9rPwXAAD__z-Jf-Y) after 141 years of selling ice cream, pralines, and other sweet treats. The owners explained the decision by citing "changing market conditions and the long-term sustainability of our operations." The business was founded in 1878 by William Wirt Lamme of St. Louis as the Red Front Candy Factory. After Lamme lost the business in a game of poker, his son [bought it back](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu3CAYhJ8Gd6zgXwy4oEjj7qRNaXH5baNwOTLsev32kVOlTzufNJr5fn0tXzamWLafNqPpn7UuBc-WsHc8ls1md0MbQvQ91uJtCVfb6wIMJGWCgl6CjelaxBCMY2HiAxqulHoqwRUfduNAjZOctAP5DNZjYJ6xFb3TQnjmxiGau4wJ0JwzEPoBSq3IJdernMaVayIYhtjr8eg7dvzYtqarvvF4-JqHZPbevxt5_iAwE5jP83z8fr_whgRme_ToExKYcy14EZjdq8WCrRGYW7Yp0X-CZHPGRu-bERu1r9ZjoT7VFstGYAY50VFa5jQ4aoVwVIBcqePhSTnCxLTwkjs_HCZ8nzGl2KQigm3ZxvR3bv8_yW8DfwIAAP__ufiPrA) for $800 and reopened it as Lammes Candies in 1885. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | Dear Fellow Arizonan, Let me set the table for you... It is now me versus Greg Stanton. American Veteran and doctor versus career politician. And there is so much reason for hope. Greg Stanton has a problem. He is facing a primary challenge from the far-left activist Kai Newkirk, and Stanton is sprinting further LEFT to survive it. That means the man who's been rubber-stamping the radical Democrat agenda in Washington is about to get even more out of touch with the families, small businesses, and communities of Congressional District 4. I am here to make sure CD-04 doesn't pay the price. I am a Navy veteran, a physician who has served this community for over 25 years, and the son of immigrants who came to America because they believed in what this country stands for. I believe that America is the greatest country on Earth, and the promise of the American Dream needs to be protected for generations to come. While Stanton has been cozying up to the left-wing establishment in Washington, voting in lockstep with the most radical members of his party, I have been treating patients and fighting for individual liberty for all people, no matter their party registration. Our priorities focus on what we hear from YOU: ✅ Affordability ✅ Healthcare ✅ Restoring the American Dream ✅ Keeping our neighborhoods and our country safe Stanton is ready to spend millions on a seat he has used only to serve himself and to push his party's extreme agenda. With no primary opponent this cycle, every dollar you give to my campaign goes directly toward defeating Greg Stanton and his out-of-touch agenda this November. == I am ready to fight. I hope you will join me. -Dr. Zuhdi Jasser P.S. -- Stanton's far-left primary challenger is already forcing him to abandon the center. # Announcing TFVC's New Political Director
|

---
| Texans for Vaccine Choice is excited to announce the hiring of **Emily Cameron as our new Political Director**. In 2022, in the prime of her life as a competitive bodybuilder, Emily survived a **life-threatening vaccine injury** that reshaped her life and ignited her passion for medical liberty. TFVC President and Co-founder Rebecca Hardy noted of Cameron, “Emily’s personal story and deep experience in Texas political strategy and grassroots mobilization will be invaluable as we continue to **expand our impact at the Capitol and across the state**. Emily’s passion resonates deeply with the families we serve, and her ability to turn conviction into action makes her a **powerful addition to our team**.” On the occasion of her hiring, Cameron stated, “After everything my family and I have walked through, I feel a **deep responsibility** to stand up for others facing similar challenges. Texans deserve the freedom to make their own **medical decisions without coercion or discrimination** , and I’m honored to join Texans for Vaccine Choice in the fight to protect those rights and amplify the voices of everyday Texans.” Emily and her husband, Colt, live in the Fort Worth area with their three children.

There are things that cowards like Trump will never understand.
Service, for one. Sacrifice. Honor. Obligation. Trust.
Giving your life for your friends, your country, or a cause is the most sacred sacrifice you can make. When you join the Military, you accept that you might be asked to make that sacrifice. And you do it, willingly, because you believe the United States of America and our people are worth the risk.
But what about Afghans who believed so much in the United States of America that they put their lives on the line for us? Who went out with Americans every day and had their six in the worst situations you can imagine. We made promises to those people: have our back today, and we’ll have yours tomorrow.
To Trump, their service and sacrifice were worthless. The promises we made and the obligations we have to them mean nothing to him. And as of this week, Trump gave them two options: Go to the Congo, or go back to Afghanistan — where they will be killed.

name: Tracey Mann
subject: I need your help before April ends
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mann for Congress, Inc
body:
The numbers we post at the end of April matter more than most people realize. | | | [ ](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=1240eee5cd&e=a9d1410029)
---
| |
---
| | Peter Willis, I wanted to reach out personally before our end-of-month deadline.

The numbers we post at the end of April matter more than most people realize.

They send a clear signal to the Left and outside groups looking at Kansas. Are we strong and ready to defend the **Big First** , or do they see an opportunity?

And with the Kansas filing deadline quickly approaching, what we do right now will shape how this race is viewed heading into that critical moment.

I’ll be honest with you — we’re not where we need to be yet.

Right now, we’re about 65% of the way to our goal, and **we need a strong push over the next few days to close the gap.**

If we fall short, they’ll see it as an opening to target Kansas.

I’m not going to let that happen.

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2150%2E259176%2Em-ybpS) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2150%2E259176%2Em-ybpS)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11099?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.28_Troye-Trump-Oval-Office_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=4&akid=2150%2E259176%2Em-ybpS) **I was in Trump’s Oval Office. Now I’m one of MAGA’s greatest enemies — and I recently announced my run for Congress.** They tried to silence me. Trump pretended he never met me. His press secretary called me a failure. Kash Patel threatened me with litigation. His MAGA allies harassed me, tried to bankrupt me, and even threatened to kill me. They thought that would stop me. They were dead wrong. **My name is Olivia Troye, and I'm announcing my campaign for Congress in Virginia.** [**If you’re ready to elect someone who knows how to go toe-to-toe with Trump and his MAGA allies, I’m hoping I can count on you to become a Founding Donor to my campaign by splitting $10 between me and Blue Amp Action straight away. >>**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11099?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.28_Troye-Trump-Oval-Office_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T1&t=5&akid=2150%2E259176%2Em-ybpS) I'm the daughter of a truck driver and a Mexican immigrant. I grew up in a working-class Texas border town and learned English watching Sesame Street. After my parents divorced, my mom and I leaned on family and made ends meet without health insurance. When I found out my stepfather was abusing her, I helped her flee in the middle of the night. **So Peter, I know what it means to fight when the stakes are real.** After September 11th, I felt called to serve. I went to work at the Pentagon, spent a year in a warzone in Iraq, and served under both President Bush and President Obama in counter-terrorism roles. Then I saw MAGA up close – and it's even more dangerous than you think. So I spoke out. I told the truth about Trump's handling of COVID. About the chaos. The corruption. The cruelty. And I earned the right enemies. I'm not connected. I'm not rich. I'm not carrying a famous last name. But that's exactly why I'm running – to represent the people, not the powerful. **Northern Virginia needs a fighter in Congress. Someone who won't back down when courage requires it. | | | |
---
Peter,

At the end of this message, **[I’m going to ask you to make your first donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9981?t=8&akid=1208%2E124072%2Ebz-hY3)** But first, will you let me explain why your support – especially ahead of our end-of-month deadline – is so important?
Frankly, running for Senate wasn't part of the plan. I wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home.

Seeing all of the chaos coming out of Washington DC, I knew I had to do something. Folks had placed their trust in me throughout my career as a public servant to fight for them – and **I felt that responsibility deeply.**
This is a race I simply could not walk away from. It’s also one I know we can win.

Since launching our campaign, tens of thousands of people have joined our grassroots movement. I’m so grateful to count you as one of them, Peter.
**With a recent poll showing this race statistically tied, and far-right Republicans spending millions to defeat me, I need your help to keep up our momentum.**
**[I set a goal to raise $500,000 before our April end-of-month deadline, and I’m counting on your support to reach it. Your contribution of $5 will be put to work immediately to help us win in North Carolina and take back the Senate. Will you chip in?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/9982?amount=5&t=9&akid=1208%2E124072%2Ebz-hY3)**

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

| |
#
MEDIA CONTACT:
Michael Biundo
Email: [michael@ascent-strategic.com](mailto:michael@ascent-strategic.com) FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
April 28, 2026
Weare, NH Lily Tang Williams Calls on Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander to Refrain from Inflammatory Anti-Trump Rhetoric and Stop Stoking the Flames of Political Violence WEARE, NH – Lily Tang Williams, Republican candidate for Congress in New Hampshire’s 2nd District, today urged incumbent Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander (D-NH) to immediately tone down her divisive and inflammatory rhetoric against President Donald Trump. Williams emphasized that such language does not strengthen our Republic but instead risks inciting further political violence at a time when unity and calm are desperately needed. “As someone who lived through the horrors of Communist China, where propaganda, demonization of political opponents, and inflammatory rhetoric led to chaos, violence, and the destruction of millions of lives, I know firsthand how dangerous words can become,” said Williams. “Congresswoman Goodlander has repeatedly attacked President Trump with extreme labels and accusations that go far beyond policy disagreement. This kind of rhetoric does not serve the people of New Hampshire or our nation. It divides us, erodes trust in our institutions, and stokes the very flames of political violence we must all work to extinguish.” Williams continued: “We have seen too many tragic incidents of political violence in recent years. Every American, Republican, Democrat, or Independent, must reject language that dehumanizes opponents or implies they are a threat to society. Our Republic thrives on vigorous debate, not on treating political differences as existential threats. Congresswoman Goodlander should lead by example and refrain from stoking these dangerous flames. The people of NH-02 deserve representatives who prioritize solutions over sensationalism.” Lily Tang Williams is a Republican candidate for New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District in 2026. A proud American by choice, she is a small business owner, community leader, and chair of the New Hampshire Asian American Coalition. She previously ran for Congress in 2024 and remains committed to fighting for limited government, individual liberty, parental rights, and economic freedom for Granite Staters. ###

**But a judge may have just SAVED the future of public media, declaring Trump’s attacks a direct violation of the First Amendment!**

[**This is proof that our fight is WORKING. So we’re gathering 15,000 signatures to celebrate this incredible victory and THANK public broadcasters for refusing to back down »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108171?t=7&akid=23987%2E878179%2ETa2f_A) | [**Stand with Public Broadcasters: Chip in $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/108171?t=8&akid=23987%2E878179%2ETa2f_A)
---
TO: Public Broadcasters
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! To all public broadcasters,

Thank you. Thank you for enriching all of our lives — in rural and urban areas, and everywhere in between — with your various news and educational programs.

I couldn’t be more THRILLED to see Trump’s disgusting executive order blocked. _His authoritarian power grab didn’t stand a chance against our fight._

**I also know that Trump’s attacks on the free press don’t end here — he wants to shut down MS NOW, CNN, and anyone else who holds him accountable.**

It’s not just upsetting, _it’s a dangerous step towards an**outright dictatorship!**_ That’s why I’m not getting complacent.

[**I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $3 to VPP to thank you for your years of service and to join VPP in the fight against Trump’s attacks on the free press. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. body:
I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at Brave Books.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGK2zAURb9G3ilIT7ZkL7xIcBwKTSlhSOlKyNKzI8aygiTP_H5J6XxAt4fzHtx7f1311fjVb8sPE7BPZdYp6yn5bfl8xBVzDBgwZ7P4bZmMBgaSsppC-_J45XpnneG2wp4rpUQrmGyqR99JNbWdmlnbOGOEnWtpOs6FdI3ATqnK969XrIaWC8EZHDgwoTpQoCR2c-dIzcyKqRwSPvdp9dZsxeT3OSaLBxtDtfaPUp6ZiCOBkcCY0e4JD2ZDF8vLIDBOyXwgnWJ8zwRGULwBCy11DUpaT3VNWy5bis2kpEQ1tx0nYtxL0DnuySIRw2m40Nv5TkC-cEDn90DEcL7-I9aEp_HLRsQADBpWc6ZPw0Wfbsf7WX-7XH5D813fznf980hvb-PXWdwKboWI4fY20q8qqtS756dfV5-lIjVbgvHr37Dl_6f56OFPAAAA__9bXJW7)

| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkcGK2zAURb9G3ilIT7ZkL7xIcBwKTSlhSOlKyNKzI8aygiTP_H5J6XxAt4fzHtx7f1311fjVb8sPE7BPZdYp6yn5bfl8xBVzDBgwZ7P4bZmMBgaSsppC-_J45XpnneG2wp4rpUQrmGyqR99JNbWdmlnbOGOEnWtpOs6FdI3ATqnK969XrIaWC8EZHDgwoTpQoCR2c-dIzcyKqRwSPvdp9dZsxeT3OSaLBxtDtfaPUp6ZiCOBkcCY0e4JD2ZDF8vLIDBOyXwgnWJ8zwRGULwBCy11DUpaT3VNWy5bis2kpEQ1tx0nYtxL0DnuySIRw2m40Nv5TkC-cEDn90DEcL7-I9aEp_HLRsQADBpWc6ZPw0Wfbsf7WX-7XH5D813fznf980hvb-PXWdwKboWI4fY20q8qqtS756dfV5-lIjVbgvHr37Dl_6f56OFPAAAA__9bXJW7)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.

_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_

Courts matter. And State Supreme Courts matter A LOT.
Virginia voters just approved a redistricting measure that could deliver Democrats up to four new Congressional seats. Within 24 hours, a conservative judge blocked it.
The case is now heading to the Virginia Supreme Court -- a court with a decidedly conservative lean, chosen by a Republican-controlled legislature.
Will it uphold the will of the voters? We don't know yet. And that's the problem.

Thanks for reading By the Ballot! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYnl0aGViYWxsb3QuY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoxOTU1Njg3MTIsInMiOjUxNTY1NjYsImYiOnRydWUsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3NzczODMyNzYsImV4cCI6MjA5Mjk1OTI3NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0.yJ1wSHnmVz4YsPDiua0_dmcT6HOKT4y2t_INPS4PyCM?)
Well, Virginia, we did it. We officially joined California in the ranks of electorates that have taken the leap to do midterm redistricting to push back against Trump and his lackeys strong arming red states into drawing more Republican seats. ([For more on that, reference my last piece on this](https://substack.com/redirect/7c660061-4ac5-4eb5-b8bb-351bbe9b9bf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
On a margin of just 3 points (51.44 - 48.56), Virginia voted to approve the amendment to allow for temporary redistricting, and based on the proposed maps drawn by the Virginia Legislature, give Democrats 4 more seats in Congress, bringing the Virginia Delegation from 6D - 5R to 10 fucking 1 D to R.
The margin of victory was significantly smaller than November's, 3 points versus Spanberger's 15. While the tightness of the vote was more than the [Virginians for Fair Elections](https://substack.com/redirect/45abeb92-9917-4cef-b20f-f9c3f4be8c80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had hoped, the margins of victory in the places where the Yes Vote won were significant.
"Yes" won in [37 of 133 localities](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1a3754-ecab-44c4-946f-a87ef8e9cad1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In those 37 localities, "yes" won by an average 28.77%. The largest margin was in Petersburg, where it won by 73.78%.
The localities where Yes won big aren't the story. The story is what we just barely beat to get there.
* * *
### The Backlash to the Backlash to the Thing That's Just Begun
Trump pressured red states to redraw their maps. California and Virginia responded with midterm redistricting of our own. That part of the chain has been covered. What hasn't been covered is the third link: the operation that mobilized to stop us.
The No campaign wasn't a grassroots concern about good government. It was a paid operation. [Virginians for Fair Maps](https://substack.com/redirect/930258fd-9d0c-4110-8748-a7e3f588ef77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) pulled in around $22 million, co-chaired by Eric Cantor and Jason Miyares. [Justice for Democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/3d75da4b-05df-436e-80fc-648dd61e10a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the dark-money PAC running cover, took in another $6.9 million. $6.5 million of that came from a single shell called [Per Aspera Policy Inc.](https://substack.com/redirect/fa91f5e1-e2d6-4efa-aadd-ad92fd12befc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which traces back to [Peter Thiel](https://substack.com/redirect/e16f3d91-d081-4348-a224-ffc5afe9393d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's 94 cents on every dollar Justice for Democracy raised. Glenn Youngkin personally [chipped in over $500,000](https://substack.com/redirect/cd7c4844-0c58-4d7d-b8ef-997a567b8c42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of his own money. [A.C. Cordoza](https://substack.com/redirect/fa91f5e1-e2d6-4efa-aadd-ad92fd12befc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), chair of Justice for Democracy, refused to say where the money came from. And then they flew in the talent: Scott Presler to call the amendment an "unconstitutional power grab," Sean Spicer to lend whatever credibility he has left, and [Meghan McCain to bring George Santos on her podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/42253817-1012-42d3-afbb-186bac30e485?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to bash Abigail Spanberger.
Justice for Democracy spent some of that money on [mailers to Black Virginia voters](https://substack.com/redirect/e16f3d91-d081-4348-a224-ffc5afe9393d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) comparing the redistricting referendum to Jim Crow and the KKK. The [NAACP](https://substack.com/redirect/586bfce9-88f6-4703-b690-f9781f3e4b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) called the ads "manipulative" and "racist." [Attorney General Jay Jones](https://substack.com/redirect/e16f3d91-d081-4348-a224-ffc5afe9393d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) called them an attempt to suppress Black voter participation by exploiting the history of the Civil Rights Movement. That was the operation.
The same Scott Presler who two months earlier was in [Indiana, threatening Republican lawmakers](https://substack.com/redirect/6d35cd3d-58f3-49fc-b876-07db51e40ec9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who wouldn't gerrymander aggressively enough. The same Scott Presler who before that was in Utah, [collecting signatures to dismantle that state's anti-gerrymandering law](https://substack.com/redirect/7c660061-4ac5-4eb5-b8bb-351bbe9b9bf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The hypocrisy isn't incidental. It's the operation.
This is what we just beat by 3 points. In one state. With Spanberger at the top of the ticket and 15 points of momentum behind us. The same operation, the same money, the same operatives, the same manufactured "power grab" framing, it's loading up right now to fight the next blue state that tries this. And the one after that.
If California and Virginia are the only states that move, we absorbed the full force of that opposition alone. We did it on a 3-point margin. The next state to try this gets the same operation, just as well-funded, just as well-organized, with the added benefit of the lessons they learned watching us.
But if a third state moves, the operation has to split. Their money has to go two places. Their operatives have to pick which state to fly into. Their national press attention dilutes. A fourth state and the math gets worse for them. A fifth and it breaks.
Two states means we fought the whole apparatus alone. Three states splits it. Five states breaks it. The math isn't optional. We need more Dems.
But more Dems is the external problem. There's an internal one too. And the 3-point margin is where it lives.
* * *
### Mind The 12-Point Gap
Here's a number that should bother every Democrat in Virginia: 12.
That's the difference between [Spanberger's margin in November](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1a3754-ecab-44c4-946f-a87ef8e9cad1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (15) and the amendment's margin in April (3). Same state. Same off-year electorate, more or less. Five months apart.
Twelve points evaporated.
Now, some of that was always going to happen. Ballot questions underperform candidates. They always have. People show up to vote for a person, not a paragraph buried halfway down the ticket. (If you've ever worked a polling location, you've watched it happen in real time. Voter walks in, votes for the top of the ticket, hands the ballot back, walks out. Gov, Lt. Gov, AG, done. They didn't even see Question 1.)
But 12 points isn't drop-off. 12 points is something else.
[Spanberger won 64 of 133 localities](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1a3754-ecab-44c4-946f-a87ef8e9cad1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The amendment won 37. Do the math on that. There are at least 27 localities in Virginia where voters showed up for a Democratic governor in November and then either stayed home in April or voted no on giving her the tools to do the job they elected her to do.
Let's be precise about what that means. The base showed up. Where Yes won, Yes won big. Petersburg by 73 points, an average margin of nearly 29 in the 37 localities we carried. That's the Democratic base loud and proud. The base isn't the problem.
The problem is the ring around the base.
The exurbs. The small cities. The Spanberger-curious moderates who broke for her in November because she's a former CIA officer and a serious person and not whatever Winsome Earle-Sears was offering. They liked the candidate. They were not, it turns out, sold on the project.
That's the 2026 problem in one sentence: the voters we need to hold the House aren't sold on the project. They're sold on the candidates.
(And before anyone in my mentions starts in on it: no, this isn't a screed against the voters. The voters did the work in November. The voters showed up _again_ in April, in an off-year, on a single-issue ballot question, in numbers that would have been unimaginable a decade ago. Turnout wasn't the failure. _Persuasion_ was.)
Somewhere between November 4th and April 21st, the No campaign successfully convinced enough Spanberger voters that giving Democrats four more seats in Congress was a "power grab" rather than a response to one. They had $29 million and Jim Crow mailers and Scott fucking Presler to do it. We had a 15-point governor and the truth.
The truth wasn't enough. The truth was enough by 3 points.
Read that again. The truth was enough _by 3 points_.
Three points is also, for whatever it's worth, [a wider margin than Glenn Youngkin won by in 2021](https://substack.com/redirect/965538d5-8071-4a47-a415-ca037ebd9ca7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The man who spent his post-governorship trying to kill this amendment, who personally cut a $500,000 check against it, who held rallies and did Fox hits opposing it, lost the referendum by a margin larger than the one that put him in the governor's mansion in the first place. That is not a footnote. That is the headline they don't want printed.
If we walk into 2026 thinking the truth will carry us, we are going to lose seats we should hold. The voters who got us to 51.44 are the same voters who'll decide the [Second](https://substack.com/redirect/67e5a20e-9131-4293-a443-5723e4c53a5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [Seventh](https://substack.com/redirect/4507193d-20f0-4685-b2f4-d1335c97294c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [Tenth](https://substack.com/redirect/f4489149-42b0-45b4-b92f-597265649043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And now the First, the Fifth, and the Sixth. And they are not on autopilot. They have to be persuaded every single time. With every cycle. About every single fight.
That's the warning. Read the margin.
The persuasion was the failure. And persuasion isn't an ad budget. Persuasion is what you've delivered when you ask for the next vote.
* * *
### The Bill Comes Due
Here's the thing about asking voters to give you four more seats in Congress: at some point, they're going to ask what you did with them.
Not in 2026. Not on day one of the new majority. But sometime between now and the next time we need them to show up for a structural fight, the voters in those 27 localities, the ones who broke for Spanberger but balked on the amendment, are going to want a receipt. They're going to want to know whether the four seats we just spent [$64 million](https://substack.com/redirect/1ebad7c0-d50b-4855-bda8-68b32b7f6a44?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and three points of margin to get were worth the trouble.
That answer is on us. Not on Trump. Not on Mike Johnson. Not on the No coalition. _Us_.
(And before the "but the filibuster" crowd starts in: yes, I know. We're talking about a House delegation, not the Senate. Stay with me.)
What does delivery look like? It's the question Democrats have been bad at answering for a decade. We are very good at telling voters what we are _against_. We are very good at telling voters what _they_ are against. What we have not been consistently good at, especially in Virginia, is telling voters what they are going to _get_ when they hand us power.
So let me try.
A 10-1 delegation means four more Democratic votes for [Medicare for All](https://substack.com/redirect/14613234-c5dd-4833-b81c-f229a6bb01f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It means four more votes for the [PRO Act](https://substack.com/redirect/46e63c37-ce7b-4557-bdb1-1d016d08d7ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It means four more votes to bring the [rampant, unaccountable ICE activity tearing through our communities](https://substack.com/redirect/ffae0ae2-009c-4dee-85b4-c62196dbb66b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a halt. And it means four more votes to finally put a real check on the Trump Administration, instead of negotiating against ourselves while he tests every guardrail left.
That's the project. That's what we asked Virginians to vote yes on, even if we didn't say it out loud. The map was the means. The delivery is the end.
And here's where I'm going to say something that's going to get me yelled at in the replies: Democrats in Washington have a delivery problem that predates this referendum.
We have spent the last decade winning majorities, losing them, winning them back, and presiding over a government that still hasn't passed Medicare for All, still hasn't passed the PRO Act, still hasn't reined in the deportation machine, and still spends more time managing Trump than stopping him. We have had the votes at moments that mattered. We have not always used them.
That track record is what made the 12-point gap possible. The Spanberger voters who skipped the amendment weren't fooled by Peter Thiel's mailers. They were _unconvinced_. They looked at the case for giving Democrats more power and they said, in effect, "show me what you did with the power you already had."
That is a fair question. It is the question.
Let me be specific, because vague self-criticism is just self-flagellation with extra steps.
In 2009, Democrats had the White House, the House, and 60 votes in the Senate. We passed the [Affordable Care Act](https://substack.com/redirect/18babfbb-c4f7-4686-a770-e801a266b49a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is real, which saved lives, which I will defend until I am in the ground. We also let the [public option die in committee](https://substack.com/redirect/34c48aa7-7813-46d0-b05e-62b05b42c309?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because Joe Lieberman wanted to be courted. We declined to codify Roe when we had the runway. We had the most progressive trifecta of my lifetime and we governed like we were borrowing the keys.
In 2021, Democrats had the White House, the House, and a 50-50 Senate with a tiebreaker. We passed the [American Rescue Plan](https://substack.com/redirect/003848c8-75f1-430d-b8f7-3ba308498cd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [Inflation Reduction Act](https://substack.com/redirect/61e1392c-a644-42fa-b60a-63dbdda34398?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the [bipartisan infrastructure law](https://substack.com/redirect/67326c4a-feb9-43c8-80e2-8ff7d0780165?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the [CHIPS Act](https://substack.com/redirect/1751464b-caa7-4611-ab53-eb58e1c33c9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Real bills. Real money. Real delivery. And we also watched [Build Back Better get gutted by Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema](https://substack.com/redirect/3b7e1662-1408-4ce0-8c03-fc76581adb05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while leadership negotiated against itself for eighteen months. We watched the [John Lewis Voting Rights Act](https://substack.com/redirect/69a6a5af-d962-456f-817d-aa4e4fc253ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) die because we wouldn't blow up the filibuster to save it. We watched [Medicare expansion get traded for an electric vehicle tax credit](https://substack.com/redirect/e781d6a2-1257-4427-9ef2-01695fb6616a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because Manchin's spreadsheet said so.
(I'm not relitigating the 2021-22 cycle to make anyone feel bad. I'm relitigating it because the voters in those 27 localities lived through it. They watched it happen in real time. They are not stupid. They remember what got passed and what got dropped. And when the No campaign told them that giving Democrats more power doesn't actually translate into Democrats _using_ power, they had four years of receipts to back the claim up.)
This is the part that makes me angriest, and I want to be honest about it: we keep treating delivery like it's a separate problem from messaging. It isn't. Delivery _is_ the message. When we passed the ACA, we didn't have to explain to voters what the ACA was. They felt it. When we [failed to pass voting rights](https://substack.com/redirect/6197a43d-995d-4618-8f84-fe5da226ba17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we didn't have to explain that either. They felt that too.
The voters who gave Spanberger 15 points and gave the amendment 3 are not confused about what Democrats are for. They are confused about whether Democrats can _do_ what Democrats are for. And every cycle we hand them another round of "we tried but Manchin," another round of "we'll get it next time," another round of leadership press conferences explaining why this wasn't the moment, the gap gets wider.
The 12-point gap isn't a polling problem. It's a trust problem. And you don't fix a trust problem with a better ad budget. You fix it by doing the thing.
(I'll say it the way Senator Lucas would: they started it, and we are _fucking_ finishing it. But finishing it means actually finishing it. Not just winning the seats. Using them.)
So here's what delivery looks like in practice. It looks like the new 10-1 delegation walking into Washington and voting like they mean it on every single one of the bills above, even when leadership tells them to wait. It looks like Spanberger spending political capital on the fights that hurt instead of the fights that poll well. It looks like every Democrat in this state, from Richmond to the Ninth, treating the next 4 years like the audition they are.
Because here's the part nobody wants to say out loud: the 10-1 map isn't permanent. It's _temporary_. It expires after the 2030 census. We have between now and then to convince Virginians that we earned it. That we used it. That when we asked them for the keys, we drove somewhere worth going.
If we do, the next structural fight is easier. The next blue state that tries this has a model. The 12-point gap closes. The base grows. The ring around the base gets pulled in.
If we don't, we hand the No campaign their next ad. _They asked you for four more seats and gave you nothing._ And the next time we need to ask voters to show up for the project, they will remember. They always do.
So to every Democrat reading this who is celebrating today: good. Celebrate. We earned it. We beat $29 million, Jim Crow mailers, Scott Presler, Sean Spicer, Meghan McCain, Eric Cantor, Jason Miyares, Glenn Youngkin's checkbook, and Peter Thiel's shell company. That is not nothing.
But Wednesday morning, we go back to work. Because the win isn't the win. The delivery is the win.
Give people a reason to vote _for_ us, not just against the other guy.
That's the whole job. That's always been the whole job.
The map gave us the seats. The seats are not the point.
The point is what we do with them.
* * *
#### **TL;DR**
* Virginia approved midterm redistricting by 3 points, taking the delegation from 6-5 R to 10-1 D. The win is real. The margin is the warning.
* The amendment passed by a wider margin than Glenn Youngkin won the governorship by in 2021. He spent half a million dollars of his own money trying to kill it.
* The No campaign was a $29 million paid operation funded by Peter Thiel through a shell, fronted by Cantor, Miyares, Youngkin, Presler, Spicer, and McCain. We beat it alone. The next blue state that moves splits the operation. The fifth state breaks it. **We need more Dems.**
* 12 points evaporated between Spanberger's November margin and the amendment's April margin. The base showed up. The ring around the base did not. That's the 2026 problem.
* The voters we need to hold the House aren't confused about what Democrats are for. They're confused about whether Democrats can _do_ what Democrats are for. The 12-point gap isn't a polling problem. It's a trust problem.
* The 10-1 map is temporary. It expires after 2030. We have between now and then to convince voters we earned it by using it. Medicare for All, the PRO Act, ending rampant ICE activity, and putting a real check on the Trump Administration is what delivery looks like.
* Give people a reason to vote _for_ us, not just against the other guy. The map gave us the seats. The point is what we do with them.

California and Virginia responded with midterm redistricting of our own. That part of the chain has been covered. What hasn't been covered is the third link: the operation that mobilized to stop us. We need more Dems. But more Dems is the external problem. There's an internal one too. And the 3-point margin is where it lives.
