**My political heart changed because becoming a Democrat has made it easier for me to love my neighbor.** As a Republican, if someone didn’t look like me, act like me or vote like me, I couldn’t love them. I couldn’t justify that.
* **Georgians are facing an affordability crisis,** with prices skyrocketing for essentials like food and housing -- but Republicans lack the courage to stand up to Trump and his reckless tariffs.

* **More than ten percent of Georgians are uninsured** \-- and Republicans’ refusal to extend Affordable Care Act tax credits will drive that number even higher, forcing more of our neighbors to make impossible decisions when they get sick.

* **Nearly twenty percent of children in Georgia lack consistent access to food** \-- and Republicans have made the problem worse by slashing funding for SNAP and programs that provide meals to kids in school.

For decades, Republicans have told people without health insurance, food security, or access to housing to just “get a job.”

**Now, as a proud Democrat, I wake up every day with a better set of tools to serve those in need and to fight for the people of Georgia.**

As Governor, I’ll set the priorities for our state, and I believe we should help our neighbors who need it the most. But first we need to win -- and I can’t do it without your help. **_[So please: Will you donate today so we can finally elect a Democratic governor in Georgia? As a Republican, if someone didn’t look like me, act like me or vote like me, I couldn’t love them. I couldn’t justify that. Georgians are facing an affordability crisis, with prices skyrocketing for essentials like food and housing -- but Republicans lack the courage to stand up to Trump and his reckless tariffs. More than ten percent of Georgians are uninsured \-- and Republicans’ refusal to extend Affordable Care Act tax credits will drive that number even higher, forcing more of our neighbors to make impossible decisions when they get sick. Nearly twenty percent of children in Georgia lack consistent access to food \-- and Republicans have made the problem worse by slashing funding for SNAP and programs that provide meals to kids in school. For decades, Republicans have told people without health insurance, food security, or access to housing to just “get a job.” Now, as a proud Democrat, I wake up every day with a better set of tools to serve those in need and to fight for the people of Georgia. Patriot,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. **Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you.** **[In light of America’s 250th birthday and the special opportunity we have to honor veterans this year, will you chip in today to help support the parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=1fb4d18391214e65b7b9a4aa792831fc&_e=FD99XXsKxbrDsXgu6PtEptAirfx_waFuqh0em2Ah9hEv4NT_AFgB4zZXUcaJUUmpVBgHvkrygtkOevHd7uMwfHM7XFqP5Zmgl_3Ui2WoYJcy6hGsIGYGqslk9C6N-xusTm7sMgGUcj3-9wuzZJGjxAqg6VCY4s3lnwywo-wHEgR2F-1JMgkCLQb1bIxteUWRc7b54ePjQOeIrUkAWCeYw_EOl_ImQzmJd4kk0eQfkRP9hRjRQTb4beP7pNlL0r8WbM8E_-qD83utN88X5eKmLaAXBMEvWzVOFw-zjK_FMAH45V6mezKUgKyrkovWTHTh8rqmApOfI_YXIY9EGahKXA22s40-66Q-syv6nLyj9EBP4Jnql02AeV_y4EcwtPYMl1AFkjCSSMWfJBgbzd8jersx5Anj4inox9lC2H6SJq9vmZjuNrrh7NaDLN4g-zSPy70Fxbu_3NgGmMmFLPJ8__2iPAomMMmWNKPCS0kBci7IHqNEgpwiR9jVf_2VVfEa_qi3KL7jrghqWNmK8eD9xfu4rOTtFdvTGaS4Ct5q4tqpXy6l3Dj_IJujelJo7i1xouMwta_gWsQItCBBnGXZVv96ljT_yL6X-TtOKoRS_5mnrPMFMTI--m_4Qa7zROJiTtfWoVLfxOzZhIrF1p6AhDk0wUi6tSutDakyYYoFIc1AbMrvW_BGMADf8q8FbiBz)**

# [Tell ABC: "Don’t Let Trump Silence Jimmy Kimmel"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3c058ade-5a70-4c85-ba94-19d801ec25a7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | _(Already took this action?[Click here for others](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf28fb55b-e93e-414a-8953-8f5903bbd82b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Want to unsubscribe? See link below)_ Donald and Melania Trump are [pressuring ABC to fire Jimmy Kimmel](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8cf0ffe9-05e0-443c-8797-4cc267f4ffe2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) over a joke they didn't like. **Let's be clear: that's not accountability. That's an attempt to bully a network into silencing a critic.** On his show last week — before the dinner incident — Kimmel [joked](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf9bbad99-9780-4969-832d-f41f9fad6940/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) that Melania had the "glow" of an "expectant widow," a line aimed at widely reported concerns about Donald Trump's age and health. It wasn't a threat. It wasn't a call to violence. It was satire — the kind late-night comedians have used for decades to hold powerful people up to the light. **[Tell ABC:"Don't Let Trump Silence Jimmy Kimmel"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T69102e57-451b-41b4-8ded-44f691dc3fdb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** The Trumps have every right to be offended. They can criticize Kimmel all they want. **But demanding he be fired — and backing that demand with the implied power of a federal government that regulates broadcast networks — crosses a dangerous line. That's not free speech. That's political pressure aimed at censorship.** If media companies start folding every time a powerful politician gets angry, then criticism becomes risky... and silence becomes the safer option. ABC must not cave.

clean_body: Defend free speech! | | | | | | | | | | | | | (Already took this action?. Want to unsubscribe? See link below) Donald and Melania Trump are over a joke they didn't like. Let's be clear: that's not accountability. That's an attempt to bully a network into silencing a critic. On his show last week — before the dinner incident — Kimmel that Melania had the "glow" of an "expectant widow," a line aimed at widely reported concerns about Donald Trump's age and health. It wasn't a threat. It wasn't a call to violence. It was satire — the kind late-night comedians have used for decades to hold powerful people up to the light. The Trumps have every right to be offended. They can criticize Kimmel all they want. But demanding he be fired — and backing that demand with the implied power of a federal government that regulates broadcast networks — crosses a dangerous line. That's not free speech. That's political pressure aimed at censorship. If media companies start folding every time a powerful politician gets angry, then criticism becomes risky... and silence becomes the safer option. ABC must not cave. | | | | | | | Thank you, and remember to SHARE THIS to help keep up the pressure! body:
There is no one tougher, more relentless, and no one more committed to the America First agenda than Chip Roy.

| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn2hj0haocn9iinm09dego3nu3hcdr4gmk209o8g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5g68o36clh2bs)
Things are getting serious in Texas, Fellow Patriot.

My friend, Chip Roy, is in a runoff for Texas Attorney General. Everything is on the line.

I've known Chip a long time - and I don't say this lightly: There is no one tougher, more relentless, and no one more committed to the America First agenda than Chip Roy.

He's stood shoulder to shoulder with President Trump, fighting to undo the damage of the Biden years and restore law and order, secure our border, and defend the Constitution.

In Congress, Chip has taken on the cartels flooding our communities with drugs and crime. He's fought to protect the integrity of our elections. And he's been a leading voice demanding real border security - not empty promises.

**Now, in this runoff, the stakes couldn't be higher.**

The establishment is coming for Chip Roy. California billionaires and special interest groups are pouring into Texas to try to buy this election.

_They know Chip won't bend.
They know he can't be bought.
And that's exactly why they're trying to stop him._

Texas is the backbone of conservative leadership in this country. We cannot allow coastal elites to come in, meddle in our elections, and install someone who won't fight.

Texas doesn't need just any Republican.

Texas needs a proven conservative warrior - someone who will stand up to the radical Left, defend the rule of law, and take the fight directly to those trying to undermine our state.

**[That fighter is Chip Roy.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcb2b4703bosg52e4gs8q5e6dghfdorqd2ag04ng_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5g68o36clh2bs)**

[** STAND WITH CHIP ★ **](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zclefr0tqus6crodcd6o1448nbfucbeullb9jqsg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5g68o36clh2bs)
With the runoff underway, every dollar matters. The other side is spending big, and we need to make sure Chip has the resources to finish this fight and win.

**[Please chip in $15, $25, or whatever you can today to help Chip Roy win this critical runoff and keep Texas in the hands of Texans, not California billionaires or someone who has never tried a case in court.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs1fa6drolqa28oihe7ei749qfu3vu14835odiv0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7c5g68o36clh2bs)**

Washington may be losing a fighter, but Texas needs him now more than ever.

And I'm proud to stand with Chip Roy, and I hope you will too, Fellow Patriot.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Chris Pappas. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:
**[Split a donation between me and Chris Pappas. $5 or anything you can afford.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260428_1.39ogZB&refcode=em20260428-1&t=1&akid=6361%2E582294%2EV4UI4U)**

Thanks so much,
Mark

### April 28, 2026 Newsletter

| |
# Can Something Be Done to Protect Our Kids from the Dangers of AI?
---
| |
---
| | AI is no longer a distant concept — it's woven into nearly every part of modern life. Its advances in medicine, technology, and business offer undeniable benefits. Yet there is a growing concern we can't ignore: the emotional and social impact on our kids as they interact more deeply with chatbots and digital companions. AI is everywhere, but not without moms voicing concerns and seeking answers, as we hear repeated stories of the dangers associated with children's use of AI. Tragically, there have been cases of children who died by suicide after developing relationships with chatbots. What these cases have in common is that the parents had no idea these chatbot "relationships" were taking place in their own homes. These interactions can become addictive and appear to be leading young people — and many adults — toward a kind of social withdrawal and distorted thinking that can result in delusions and dangerous behavior. Despite these heartbreaking stories and the safeguards being considered, the greatest opportunity to protect our children still lies within the family. Read the full blog to learn what you can do by joining our free membership at Moms TownSquare.

### Time-Tested Education vs. AI
---
| |
---
| | As Artificial Intelligence continues to reshape the workforce, many mothers are asking a pressing question: "What kind of education will actually prepare my child for the future?" In our latest podcast episode, Dr. Kathleen O'Toole of Hillsdale College offers a surprising and powerful answer — one rooted not in technology, but in the timeless tradition of classical education. From critical thinking and logic to rhetoric and the great ideas of Western civilization, Dr. O'Toole makes the case that these foundational skills are precisely what the automated economy cannot replace. If you're thinking seriously about how to equip your children to truly thrive in a rapidly changing world, this conversation is for you. Its advances in medicine, technology, and business offer undeniable benefits. Yet there is a growing concern we can't ignore: the emotional and social impact on our kids as they interact more deeply with chatbots and digital companions. AI is everywhere, but not without moms voicing concerns and seeking answers, as we hear repeated stories of the dangers associated with children's use of AI. Tragically, there have been cases of children who died by suicide after developing relationships with chatbots. What these cases have in common is that the parents had no idea these chatbot "relationships" were taking place in their own homes. These interactions can become addictive and appear to be leading young people — and many adults — toward a kind of social withdrawal and distorted thinking that can result in delusions and dangerous behavior. body:
This is the most powerful thing in politics
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2188%2E791427%2EIWyOTZ)
Friend — Back in January, we were in dire straits.
Trump brought the full force of federal immigration enforcement down on Minnesota. It was a clear attempt to punish my neighbors for rejecting Trump in the 2024 election and daring to stand by the Somali-American community in the face of harassment and hate campaigns.
**All hell broke loose.**
ICE essentially suspended civil rights, including the right to protest and protections against unlawful searches and seizures. Countless protesters and legal observers were brutalized. Innocent people were targeted and had their homes raided. Two of my constituents were murdered in cold blood. Hundreds, if not thousands, were hauled off to detention camps, many without due process. ICE and DHS did everything they could to instill a culture of fear and authoritarianism.
But among all of that ugliness, we saw something beautiful: **Solidarity.**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260428-1-180&t=2&akid=2188%2E791427%2EIWyOTZ)

[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260428-1-180&t=6&akid=2188%2E791427%2EIWyOTZ)
Solidarity is truly the most powerful thing in politics. From vigils and mutual aid, to marches, strikes, and protests, to neighborhood watches and community organizing, Minneapolis and all of Minnesota proved that we have each other’s backs. That we keep each other safe, not violent federal agents who don’t give a damn about their fellow Americans.
**This kind of solidarity is what frightens MAGA the most.** Because the truth is that a majority of Americans of all backgrounds and political leanings are completely fed up with Trump and his agenda of brutality.
If we can stand together rather than be divided, if we can resolve to help each other rather than fear each other, we will always be more powerful than the paper-tiger that is MAGA fascism.

body:
Tell the state to stop using taxpayers as unwilling venture capitalists.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/aa05a7ebc24b/transparencyneeded?e=d842fb25cc)

|

| | Dear Friend,

North Dakota taxpayers are being forced to bankroll private businesses through the back door.
The Legislature appropriates the money.
Commerce passes it along.
A quasi-private “development fund” hands it out.
And transparency disappears.
That is not economic development.That is government picking winners and losers with your money — while keeping taxpayers in the dark.
If public dollars are involved, every recipient, every loan, every grant, every default, every write-off, and every sweetheart deal should be public.
No more shell games.
No more “investment” excuses.
No more hiding behind bureaucracy.
North Dakotans deserve lower taxes, honest budgets, and full transparency.
**Taxpayer money should not become secret money.**

---
[|
---](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=2edfff68d3&e=d842fb25cc)
| |
**Help me ensure that North Dakota spends only on what is essential, and taxes you only what is necessary.

**[**Donate $26 >>>
Donate $69 >>>
Donate $123 >>>
Donate $350 >>>
Donate $500 >>>
Donate any amount to help get Rick back in the legislature >>>**](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=061f2d6806&e=d842fb25cc)

It is not acceptable for taxpayer money to become less visible simply because it passes through another entity. The public should not have to dig through layers of bureaucracy, boards, funds, and loosely defined “investment” programs to find out who benefited from money taken from North Dakota citizens.
Private businesses should generally be funded by private investors, private lenders, and private customers — not by taxpayers who had no choice in the matter.
When I am re-elected, I will get right back in the saddle and do everything I can to keep more of your money where it belongs - in your pocket.

[Can I count on your support?](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=68e09798bf&e=d842fb25cc)

body:
But I never thought, after 25 years in the Navy and NASA, that the President of the United States would call for my arrest and execution.
#

Team —
Back when I first decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew it wouldn’t be easy. I knew there’d be a ton of travel, events, time spent on the phone and away from family.
I knew I’d have to face millions and millions of dollars spent against me and see my opponents try to drag my name through the mud. I even knew that Trump would probably go after me, personally.
But I never thought, after 25 years in the Navy and NASA, that the President of the United States would call for my arrest and execution. I prepared myself for a lot, but even that was beyond my wildest imagination.
Through it all though, I learned that millions of people I might never meet would see all of that and still have the courage to stick with me.
That’s why your support means so much to me. And it’s why I tell you so often that I can’t do this without you. Donations of $5 here or $10 there from grassroots supporters are the largest source of donations we have, by far.

body:
State’s Top House Leader Throws Support Behind Letlow’s Proven Record of Delivering for Louisiana

| | |
---
| | | | [|

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEApril 28, 2026katherine@julialetlow.com
**LOUISIANA HOUSE SPEAKER PHILLIP DEVILLIER ENDORSES JULIA LETLOW FOR U.S. SENATE** _State’s Top House Leader Throws Support Behind Letlow’s Proven Record of Delivering for Louisiana_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, announced she has received the endorsement of Louisiana House Speaker Phillip DeVillier. This adds to the growing coalition of top conservative leaders supporting her campaign across the state including Governor Jeff Landry and Attorney General Liz Murill.
Speaker DeVillier, a respected conservative voice and leader of the Louisiana House, cited Letlow’s record of standing firm in her values, delivering for Louisiana families, and working alongside President Donald Trump to advance the America First agenda.
_“Louisiana doesn’t need another vote in Washington; we need a voice that cannot be silenced,”_**said Speaker DeVillier.**_“Julia Letlow doesn't just represent our values, she lives them. From our farms to our family tables, she understands the heartbeat of this state because she’s fought in the trenches for us. She’s battle-tested, unwavering, and exactly the kind of conservative warrior we need to protect our way of life. Julia is the real deal, and she has my full endorsement.”_
Rep. Letlow said she was honored to have the support of Speaker DeVillier and emphasized the importance of strong conservative leadership at both the state and federal levels.
_“I’m grateful for Speaker DeVillier’s support and his leadership for the people of Louisiana,”_**said Congresswoman Letlow.**_“He understands what it means to stand firm in your convictions and fight for our state, and that’s exactly the kind of leadership I will bring to the United States Senate. I will never stop working to protect Louisiana families, defend our values, and deliver real results.”_
Rep. Letlow, a Monroe native, mother of two, and former educator, has represented Louisiana’s 5th Congressional District since 2021 and currently serves on the House Appropriations Committee and the Committee on Education and the Workforce. She is running as the Trump-endorsed conservative in the race, emphasizing her record of delivering for Louisiana and her commitment to the America First agenda.
This endorsement builds on the campaign’s growing momentum as it continues to earn support from conservative leaders, grassroots organizations, and voters across Louisiana ahead of the May 16 Republican primary.

Peter,
---
It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. body:
I’m running for Governor to meet this unique moment
| Hi friend, it’s Mandela Barnes. This is a longer email - but I hope you’ll stick around to hear more of my story. You may be wondering how this kid ended up running for Governor in one of the tightest races in the country. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=2&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU) I grew up in Milwaukee, where my mom was a public school teacher. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=3&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU)
And my dad worked 3rd shift at the General Motors plant. My parents taught me the value of hard work and service. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=4&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU)
At 25, I put those lessons to practice when I was elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly, where I became a champion on issues like the environment, economy, education, racial justice, and health care. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=5&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU)
Then I helped Governor Evers kick Scott Walker out of office and became the first Black Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin, and the youngest in the country at the time. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=6&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU)
I ran for U.S. Senate against the incumbent, where tens of millions of dollars of dark money was only able to defeat me by just one point. Now I’m running for Governor to meet this unique moment where family farmers are being squeezed by tariffs. Healthcare costs keep rising. Too many families are just one emergency away from a financial disaster. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/6896?t=7&akid=6099%2E196590%2ESdq_hU) I won’t stand idly by. This election is about cutting through the constant stream of chaos that continues to divide and distract us, so that Wisconsinites no longer pay the costs of the devastation from Washington under Trump. With our end-of-April deadline Thursday at midnight, now is a crucial moment to make your first donation. I’m humbly asking: **[Before Thursday, will you please chip in $15 to help us fight for Wisconsin? ### **Local Leadership Needed.**
The traditional checks and balances appear to have broken down at the top level in Minnesota. In a State where "good" government has always been a point of pride, we must take a hard swallow and local leaders must step forward and demand change.
Tragically, the administration of elections at the state level has been overtaken by political activists. The organization and oversight of elections rests with a Secretary of State who is openly aligned with DFL-affiliated organizations. At the same time, enforcement authority at the State level lies with an Attorney General more focused on political theater than impartial execution of the law.
@Bendasense Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5kYXNlbnNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.y2ykawWDZWQ08d44LbGIp6BVz70uLAAXLcACxePN3RA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=195348264)
The next level of electiondefense lies at the local and county level in Minnesota. As outlined below, these enforcement mechanisms are producing mixed results, and local community leaders should demand more. If you're interested in learning more about these efforts, consider attending an upcoming event in the Elk River area, where I will present a detailed overview of a community-driven initiative to Protect Our Polls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70fb33c-d7a6-43e5-a930-c296da245724?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For a time, I believed the State Party would play a meaningful role in calling out fraud and demanding reform. Unfortunately, an unhealthy fixation on the donor class has prevented the party from stepping into that role. Meanwhile, the Minnesota DFL has consolidated control over two state agencies with significant, largely unchecked authority. 1 With legislative deadlock on the horizon for the foreseeable future, a local action plan is needed to restore order and calm at the polling places.
### **EVIDENCE ESTABLISHES BREAK-DOWN**
The [evidence uncovered](https://substack.com/redirect/bb3f32b1-5c0f-47e0-bdc5-8556b77946d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Sherburne and Stearns Counties in Minnesota exposes the breakdown of the checks and balances in election adminstration and enforcement. Early in the 2024 election cycle, Stearns County election officials were concerned regarding the growing problem of a local Somali group calling themselves "interpreters" flooding the polling places with groups of voters. As detailed in the police report:
> "I learned that [_The Teacher_] may be the subject of similar issues at polling locations in Stearns and Benton County (I was advised by Auditor/Treasurer staff). I contacted Stearns County Auditor/Treasurer's Office and learned that they have been dealing with an issue related to translating and voter assistance at the polling place since July 2024."
Stearns County election officials held a meeting with a group of _**8-10 active voter assistants**_. The notes from this August 12, 2024 meeting can be viewed below.
| Notes From Stearns County Lake George Po...93.1KB ∙ PDF file
---|---
| [Download](https://substack.com/redirect/90d8127d-8adb-472f-8d98-fcd3babb5763?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
As these notes show, Stearns County advised these voting assistants that they could not linger in the polling place and were prohibited from campaigning in the polling place. These officials even consultated with the Office of the Secretary of State - and a representative of the DFL Voter Alliance. Given the [fanfare](https://substack.com/redirect/021af221-7c60-49de-9e17-23b64b8e739b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) under which the Secretary of State rolled out 2 the voter assistance initiaitive, it is no surprise the OSS took no further action, nor made any attempt to report these concerns to law enforcement
As the 2024 [early voting process](https://open.substack.com/pub/bendasense/p/voting-chaos-in-minnesota?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web) progressed, these previous admonitions to these voter assistants went unheaded. Records show Sherburne County election officials faced an onslaught of 100's of voters being brought into the polling place by a single voting assistants known as _The Teacher_. As the evidence further establishes, the _Teacher_ , and his associate _The Man in Black_ , were just one of several teams 3 that were creating chaos 4 inside polling locations.
### **See Something, Say Something, Do Something**
Sherburne County election officials worked diligently to manage what they could from inside the processing area during early voting. However, the polling area--where voters were completing their ballots--was left largely unmonitored and effectively under the control of these handlers. It was only when _The Teacher_ and _The Man in Black_ made a brazen attempt to facilitate a double vote that officials were able to intervene and report their concerns to the Sherburne County Sheriff. As the current Auditor-Treasurer, put it, "We all agree that we did what we were supposed to do - see something, say something, [d]o something."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8bf36e45-298d-4c5d-827a-74b8858e54a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
##### "At 1305 hours [The Teacher] and the [Double Voter] appear to speak, then [The Teacher] escorts the "[Double Voter] to the Auditor/Treasurer window where he helps turn in the second completed ballot." Sherburne County Sheriff's Report.
The Sheriff's office took swift action and conducted a comprehensive investigation, including at least six witness interviews and the execution of two search warrants. Within two weeks of receiving the report from local election officials, a 385-page detailed report was complete and on the desk of the Sherburne County Attorney.
### **County Attorney 's Office Sidelines Voting Violations**
Based on the available evidence, it appears that the system of checks and balances broke down at the Sherburne County Attorney's Office. Following the Sheriff's report on October 21, 2024, which recommended charges against the double voter, no written action was taken by the County Attorney's Office for more than a year--until December 18, 2025.
| Decline Letter 12155KB ∙ PDF file
---|---
| [Download](https://substack.com/redirect/19b41b72-bf2d-40bc-be3f-6b5318f079f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Even if, as claimed in the attached letter, the former County Attorney reviewed the file on March 14, 2025, no official notice of that decision was ever provided, and any publicly available information remained concealed under the guise of an "ongoing investigation." The County Attorney was undoubtedly aware that disclosing the details of a voter fraud issue during an election [recount](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1eb34b-4c54-41ed-8ec1-ca24f0ea29ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--one that could have broken a tie in the Minnesota State House--would have been highly controversial. 5
Without a doubt, the County Auditor-Treasurer observed conduct that raised serious concerns. Likewise, the Sheriff's Office responded promptly, documenting the incident and preparing a detailed report. These were not the actions of officials chasing shadows--they were the measured responses of public servants who believed something warranted careful scrutiny.
Yet, instead of reinforcing this chain of accountability by taking those concerns seriously, the County Attorney chose to ignore them. In doing so, credible, front-line observations were effectively sidelined rather than investigated. That decision sends a troubling message: when local officials step forward to report irregularities, their efforts are clearly minimized rather than supported.
This breakdown in follow-through undermines confidence not only in enforcement, but in the integrity of the system itself. When those closest to the process raise red flags and are ignored, it discourages future reporting and weakens the very safeguards designed to protect the process.
The Sherburne County Auditor-Treasurer and Sheriff saw something--and acted. The County Attorney did not. This breakdown does not need to be the final word. The people of Minnesota still have a voice. The citizens of Sherburne County can--and should--[demand ](https://open.substack.com/pub/bendasense/p/voting-chaos-in-minnesota?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=web)that their polling places be secured against chaos and fraud.
1
The election-arm of the Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State is estimated to have annual budget of roughly $25-30 million per year, with 80-100 estimated full-time employees. The Office of the Attorney General of Minnesota has an estimated annual budget of $60-$65 million and 120+ full time employees.
2
"In the absence of mandatory interpreters at polling sites, the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office[ recommends](https://substack.com/redirect/27894c9b-a3f2-4186-a8c5-c3d7e5bf52af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) early or absentee voting as an alternative for those who need more time to review ballots with help from interpreters. Somali-speaking voters can access election resources, including the guide "Codbixinta Minnesota Gudaheeda" ("Voting in Minnesota"), through the Secretary of State's website."
3
According to election officials, after the double vote incident on October 4th, _The Teacher_ no longer brought in voters to the Sherburne County location. Instead, he was substituted out for another vote influencer. In the words of the election official, "they've got new people coming in and out with groups of people."
4
One Sherburne County election official described it this way, "And it's just always discombobulated becasue they're pushing things at you and they want to vote and a lot of the times they're not in the system so then you need to get information from them. And you don't know if it's really them because there's no, they don't have a picture ID..."
5
Throughout the recount process, no Sherburne County official disclosed the existence of a detailed investigative report dated October 21, 2024, which documented evidence of potential impropriety. Further, criminal charges were not filed until December 11, 2024 -- _shortly after_ the November 25 recount concluded.

As the evidence further establishes, the Teacher , and his associate The Man in Black , were just one of several teams 3 that were creating chaos 4 inside polling locations. See Something, Say Something, Do Something Sherburne County election officials worked diligently to manage what they could from inside the processing area during early voting. However, the polling area--where voters were completing their ballots--was left largely unmonitored and effectively under the control of these handlers. It was only when The Teacher and The Man in Black made a brazen attempt to facilitate a double vote that officials were able to intervene and report their concerns to the Sherburne County Sheriff. As the current Auditor-Treasurer, put it, "We all agree that we did what we were supposed to do - see something, say something, [d]o something." | | ---|---|--- "At 1305 hours [The Teacher] and the [Double Voter] appear to speak, then [The Teacher] escorts the "[Double Voter] to the Auditor/Treasurer window where he helps turn in the second completed ballot." Sherburne County Sheriff's Report. The Sheriff's office took swift action and conducted a comprehensive investigation, including at least six witness interviews and the execution of two search warrants. Within two weeks of receiving the report from local election officials, a 385-page detailed report was complete and on the desk of the Sherburne County Attorney. County Attorney 's Office Sidelines Voting Violations Based on the available evidence, it appears that the system of checks and balances broke down at the Sherburne County Attorney's Office. Following the Sheriff's report on October 21, 2024, which recommended charges against the double voter, no written action was taken by the County Attorney's Office for more than a year--until December 18, 2025. | Decline Letter 12155KB ∙ PDF file ---|--- | Even if, as claimed in the attached letter, the former County Attorney reviewed the file on March 14, 2025, no official notice of that decision was ever provided, and any publicly available information remained concealed under the guise of an "ongoing investigation." The County Attorney was undoubtedly aware that disclosing the details of a voter fraud issue during an election that could have broken a tie in the Minnesota State House--would have been highly controversial. 5 Without a doubt, the County Auditor-Treasurer observed conduct that raised serious concerns. Likewise, the Sheriff's Office responded promptly, documenting the incident and preparing a detailed report. These were not the actions of officials chasing shadows--they were the measured responses of public servants who believed something warranted careful scrutiny. Yet, instead of reinforcing this chain of accountability by taking those concerns seriously, the County Attorney chose to ignore them. In doing so, credible, front-line observations were effectively sidelined rather than investigated. That decision sends a troubling message: when local officials step forward to report irregularities, their efforts are clearly minimized rather than supported. This breakdown in follow-through undermines confidence not only in enforcement, but in the integrity of the system itself. When those closest to the process raise red flags and are ignored, it discourages future reporting and weakens the very safeguards designed to protect the process. The Sherburne County Auditor-Treasurer and Sheriff saw something--and acted. The County Attorney did not. This breakdown does not need to be the final word. The people of Minnesota still have a voice. The citizens of Sherburne County can--and should-- their polling places be secured against chaos and fraud. 1 The election-arm of the Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State is estimated to have annual budget of roughly $25-30 million per year, with 80-100 estimated full-time employees. The Office of the Attorney General of Minnesota has an estimated annual budget of $60-$65 million and 120+ full time employees. 2 "In the absence of mandatory interpreters at polling sites, the Minnesota Secretary of State's Office early or absentee voting as an alternative for those who need more time to review ballots with help from interpreters. Somali-speaking voters can access election resources, including the guide "Codbixinta Minnesota Gudaheeda" ("Voting in Minnesota"), through the Secretary of State's website." 3 According to election officials, after the double vote incident on October 4th, The Teacher no longer brought in voters to the Sherburne County location. Instead, he was substituted out for another vote influencer. In the words of the election official, "they've got new people coming in and out with groups of people." 4 One Sherburne County election official described it this way, "And it's just always discombobulated becasue they're pushing things at you and they want to vote and a lot of the times they're not in the system so then you need to get information from them. And you don't know if it's really them because there's no, they don't have a picture ID..." 5 Throughout the recount process, no Sherburne County official disclosed the existence of a detailed investigative report dated October 21, 2024, which documented evidence of potential impropriety. Further, criminal charges were not filed until December 11, 2024 -- shortly after the November 25 recount concluded. You're currently a free subscriber to . Things are getting serious in Texas, Fellow Patriot.

My friend, Chip Roy, is in a runoff for Texas Attorney General. Everything is on the line.

I've known Chip a long time - and I don't say this lightly: There is no one tougher, more relentless, and no one more committed to the America First agenda than Chip Roy.

He's stood shoulder to shoulder with President Trump, fighting to undo the damage of the Biden years and restore law and order, secure our border, and defend the Constitution.

In Congress, Chip has taken on the cartels flooding our communities with drugs and crime. He's fought to protect the integrity of our elections. And he's been a leading voice demanding real border security - not empty promises.

**Now, in this runoff, the stakes couldn't be higher.**

The establishment is coming for Chip Roy. California billionaires and special interest groups are pouring into Texas to try to buy this election.

_They know Chip won't bend.
They know he can't be bought.
And that's exactly why they're trying to stop him._

| Rudy Giuliani Read my trial update: | | Dear Patriot,
---
I spent a lot of time over the Easter weekend reflecting on the big picture of what my trial in Arizona is really all about.
---
I thought back to all the despicable things the vengeful Democrats have done to me...
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NjB9AAwAAAAAAFE9O_RBWdGapSDV1etwnbiKc2rXYratG_CJgvKKfu29v-ePaq3bJpY1qqNwvGqquhaZSO0TGTAPTwkXSSRYvRDjO-HzJ4-p0uNy8mCi)
__
---
_A dawn raid on my home.
Arresting me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Freezing my bank accounts.
Seizing my assets.
Forcing me to the point of bankruptcy._
---
**And now, a vengeful Democrat Attorney General making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
The lunatic Left’s desire to DESTROY yours truly knows no bounds.
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
But what I came to realize over the Easter holiday was that the pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**They can strip me of all I’m worth – _all I’ll ever be worth_ – but what I _REFUSE_ to surrender to the Democrats and their Deep State thugs is my LEGACY!**
---
And __that__ is what my final trial is truly all about, Patriot.
---
**I’d rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”**
---
"__For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can _NEVER_ _AGAIN_ happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I’ve got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU__.
---
Patriot, I understand this was probably the last thing on your mind today. I get it. And that’s why I always say that if you can’t afford to help me in this fight, please delete this message and carry on with your day. Don’t even think twice about it.
---
_**But if you can help, I’m going to need the best defense I can get to defeat this radical Democrat Attorney General who is hell-bent on locking me up for the rest of my life.**_
---
[**Please make a contribution to the Rudy Defense Trust to ensure I have the resources needed to retain a top-notch defense team in what is now the FINAL BATTLE for my freedom and justice.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4NjB9AAwAAAAAAFE9O_RCq6rXdXPbGFkaRkoEX7cSKbm787i5po8VEJpMYJN1zdrntm4fxt6B5geetCxewt-YyNOh8kqpJ3oG28qzMUzzmBYp36VL6qzX)

| | Peter, Something happened in a Democratic congressional primary up in New York a few months ago that **[you need to know about](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130327305/617398633/-1310582724?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUzOTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmM5Mzc1MzItMjA0My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V-VzbgFUzNzW-XWngld3ZWnHrk4SXyqnorAJaztjiCM=&emci=756344d1-1343-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=2c937532-2043-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=12426424).** A political strategist showed up to attack a candidate — but when things got messy, she couldn't even say who she was working for. Was it the campaign? An outside PAC? A shadowy Delaware consultancy? Turned out the answer was all of the above. Four separate organizations, one strategist, one coordinated hit. All of it bankrolled by a dark money network of Silicon Valley billionaires with a plan to buy Democratic primaries across the country and install their preferred candidates. **_That same operation is now working in South Carolina's 1st Congressional District_. And they've found their candidate — someone who moved here just months ago and is already asking the Lowcountry to send her to Washington.** There's just one problem. She can't even answer honestly on the record about how she feels about running as a Democrat. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130327306/617398634/691906146?refcode=SiliconValley&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUzOTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmM5Mzc1MzItMjA0My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V-VzbgFUzNzW-XWngld3ZWnHrk4SXyqnorAJaztjiCM=) A reporter from **_[The Bulwark](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130327307/617398635/-295722397?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUzOTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmM5Mzc1MzItMjA0My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V-VzbgFUzNzW-XWngld3ZWnHrk4SXyqnorAJaztjiCM=&emci=756344d1-1343-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=2c937532-2043-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=12426424)_ **watched her at a candidate forum and wrote that it "didn't always seem like she was thrilled to be running as a Democrat." When a voter asked about a woman's right to choose, she mentioned her Catholic faith and declined to give a straight answer. She has not said clearly when she became a Democrat, or why. That's exactly the kind of candidate outside money wants. Not someone with roots here. Not someone who has fought for this community. Someone who just arrived — and who won't answer straight questions — because the people writing the checks don't need her to. They just need her to win. **I am not afraid of this fight. But I need your help to win it.** I'm Mac Deford. I went to The Citadel on the GI Bill. I served as a U.S. Coast Guard federal law enforcement officer and search-and-rescue crewman in Charleston. I've served as Associate General Counsel for the Town of Mount Pleasant and as General Counsel for the Town of Hilton Head Island. I've spent my career in the Lowcountry — on the water, in the courtroom, and in the halls of local government. No PAC told me to run. No Silicon Valley billionaire is funding my campaign. Every dollar we have comes from people who live here, who love this place, and who believe the Lowcountry deserves a representative who actually knows it. **The primary is June 9. We are six weeks out. Outside money is already working to drown out your voice.** **[Fight back against dark money in our primary.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130327308/617398636/993100999?refcode=SiliconValley&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUzOTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmM5Mzc1MzItMjA0My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V-VzbgFUzNzW-XWngld3ZWnHrk4SXyqnorAJaztjiCM=)** **[DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130327309/617398637/993100999?refcode=SiliconValley&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUzOTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmM5Mzc1MzItMjA0My1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V-VzbgFUzNzW-XWngld3ZWnHrk4SXyqnorAJaztjiCM=)** Whatever you can give — $25, $50, $100 — goes directly toward reaching Lowcountry voters before June 9. Hi friends — this is an end-of-month fundraising email. I wanted to tell you right off the bat so you can delete it if you’d prefer! I understand it may not be possible to give right now (or you may just be sick of being asked).

Right now, the stakes of everything feel so high. I remember in 2016, working on Hillary Clinton’s campaign, some people said our fears about a Donald Trump presidency were unfounded. That we were “overreacting.”
A decade later, we watch videos of innocent children being detained, families being ripped apart, and Americans being murdered by masked ICE and Border Patrol agents in our communities.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
We walk by military troops deployed in our cities, patrolling our streets.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
All of that barely scratches the surface of this administration’s corruption and cruelty — and we’re only a year in.
We all know that we have to keep taking action to defend our democracy, but it’s daunting.
So here’s my promise to you: I will do every single thing in my power to fight for you and your rights. I will use every legislative tool, partner with our allies in the judicial system and out in the community, and push hard to protect our values and our freedoms.
But I’ll also tell you this — we’ll be a lot more successful in that work if we can claw back the GOP trifecta in Washington, and this November we have our chance.
My team and I are mapping out our plans for the midterms: winning re-election in CA-51, supporting my House colleagues in tough races, and boosting strong Democratic challengers in key battleground districts.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | | | If you missed silver’s run in 2025, you’re not alone.

Silver surged nearly **150% last year** — and the move may not be over.

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. "San Francisco isn't what it used to be, and it never was." Herb Caen.

"America is built on a tilt, and everything loose slides towards California." Mark Twain
There was a time--not so long ago--when California stood proudly as a bastion of investigative journalism, a place where the powerful trembled at the sound of a reporter's pen scratching against paper. In 2010 and 2011, the Golden State celebrated its storied journalistic heritage by bestowing the Mark Twain Award for Journalism Excellence upon two titans of the trade: Samuel Clemens (the man who was Mark Twain himself) and Herb Caen, the beloved three-dot columnist who served as "the voice and conscience of his city" for nearly six decades at the San Francisco Chronicle. These weren't mere golden handshakes for retired newsmen--they were declarations of principle, loud proclamations that California valued transparency, truth-telling, and the kind of muckraking courage that held institutions accountable.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6729589&post_id=195261708&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk1MjYxNzA4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzczOTU4NjUsImV4cCI6MTc3OTk4Nzg2NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTY3Mjk1ODkiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.gqC0kNG4fd3537CKVq90MQdSDvJmazh2DZm8tD7pBUo)
The California News Publishers Association still hosts its annual California Journalism Awards, but one wonders if the trophies gathering dust in their display cases feel like grave markers now--memorials to a dead ethos. Because California in 2026 has become something unrecognizable, something pitiful, something almost tragically ironic: a state that once celebrated its Mark Twains now desperately attempts to muzzle its Nick Shirleys.

Enter AB 2624, cruelly and aptly nicknamed the "Stop Nick Shirley Act"--a piece of legislative machinery so transparent in its intent that it would be laughable if it weren't so terrifying. Introduced by Assemblymember Mia Bonta (wife of California Attorney General Rob Bonta), this bill would extend the state's "Safe at Home" privacy protections--which were originally designed to shield domestic violence survivors--to immigration support service providers, their employees, and volunteers. On its surface, it claims to protect workers from harassment and threats. In reality, it creates a legal fortress around an ecosystem of government-funded nonprofits that independent journalist Nick Shirley has spent months exposing.

And oh, what exposures they have been. Shirley, a young independent journalist working outside the ossified structures of legacy media, has documented what appears to be staggering fraud in California's social services programs. His investigations have revealed "ghost" daycare centers billing taxpayers millions while operating out of empty lots and unrelated businesses. He's identified adult daycare facilities claiming $19.8 million in billing with no adults present, no enrollment information, and phone numbers that lead nowhere. His work echoes findings by Dr. Mehmet Oz, who identified a $3.5 billion hospice fraud ring in Los Angeles where 42 providers were clustered within a single four-block radius--a grotesque monument to bureaucratic incompetence and criminal ingenuity.

The response from California's ruling Democratic supermajority? Not "thank you for uncovering this theft." Not "we will investigate these allegations." No. Their response was AB 2624--a bill that would criminalize the publication of personal information or images of these "immigrant service providers" when done with intent to "threaten, intimidate, or incite violence," carrying penalties of $10,000 fines and imprisonment.

The message couldn't be clearer: expose the wrong kind of corruption, and the state will become your persecutor.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bd3f0c1c-7cfa-4588-bd52-43938a33c463?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's a breathtaking perversion of governance. While the California Journalism Awards still hand out trophies for "investigative reporting" and "public service journalism," the state's legislators work feverishly to ensure that the next generation of reporters will face misdemeanor charges for doing exactly that kind of work. The same state that proudly displayed its Mark Twain Awards in 2010 and 2011--a recognition of journalism that comforted the afflicted and afflicted the comfortable--now designs laws specifically calibrated to protect the comfortable from journalistic affliction.

How did it come to this? How did the state that gave birth to so much fearless reporting--the home of the Watergate-busting Washington Post's western spirit, the launching pad for generations of war correspondents and corruption hunters--become a place where lawmakers openly conspire to shield multi-billion-dollar fraud schemes from public scrutiny?

The answer lies in the calcification of political power. When one party controls every lever of government for decades, accountability becomes an inconvenience rather than a virtue. The nonprofits implicated in these alleged frauds--daycare operators, hospice providers, immigration service agencies--represent a constellation of interests woven tightly into California's Democratic political machine. They employ voters. They donate to campaigns. They provide the infrastructure of clientelism that keeps the party in power. Investigative journalists like Nick Shirley aren't just exposing fraud; they're threatening a political ecosystem.

For decades, California politics operated as a closed circuit of intermarried dynasties, where the Getty oil fortune served as the connective tissue binding the ruling class together. Nancy Pelosi's brother-in-law was Ron Pelosi, whose wife Barbara was the sister of Getty matriarch Ann Getty, while Dianne Feinstein's ascent in San Francisco politics paralleled the rise of this same social set--her husband Richard Blum's business dealings and the Getty family's philanthropic web creating an overlapping Venn diagram of power that few outsiders could penetrate. Gordon Getty, the opera-composing billionaire heir, mentored a young Gavin Newsom like a second son, bankrolling his early business ventures and providing the seed money that would launch his political career, even as the Pelosi and Newsom families intertwined through marriages and godparent relationships. This tight aristocratic circle--where the Browns, Newsoms, Pelosis, and Gettys socialized, intermarried, and funded each other's ambitions--meant that California's "progressive" politics were often little more than boutique causes discussed over wine at the Getty Villa, while the state's media ecosystem, dependent on access to these powerful families and their networks of donors, rarely subjected them to the kind of adversarial scrutiny that a healthy democracy requires.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18545497-bd24-4e00-9d90-1b7d4dd672ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So the state responds not by cleaning house, but by boarding up the windows. AB 2624 doesn't just protect individual workers from harassment--though its supporters will insist that's its sole purpose. It creates a zone of legal opacity around entire categories of government contractors, making it prohibitively risky for journalists or citizen watchdogs to document wrongdoing. The bill's language about "intent to threaten" is a cudgel that can be wielded against any aggressive reporting that makes its subjects uncomfortable. Under this regime, every expose becomes potentially criminal; every undercover investigation, a candidate for prosecution.

What a pathetic fall for the Golden State. The California Press Foundation still lists its Mark Twain Award recipients on its website--a roll call of honor that includes names like Ruben Salazar, the groundbreaking Chicano journalist who gave his life reporting on police violence, and Jonathan Gold, the fearless food critic who chronicled Los Angeles in all its messy glory. These were journalists who understood that their duty was to the truth, not to protecting the powerful from embarrassment. One imagines Herb Caen--who spent 58 years skewering San Francisco's elites with his poison-tipped typewriter--would be appalled at a California where journalism requires legislative permission slips.

But perhaps the saddest element of this tragedy is how unnecessary it all is. If California's political class had any confidence in the integrity of these social service programs, they would welcome scrutiny. They would join Nick Shirley in demanding answers about $170 million daycare billing for empty buildings. They would investigate the $3.5 billion hospice fraud alongside Dr. Oz rather than dismissing it as political theater. Instead, they've chosen the path of the guilty: silence the messenger, obscure the message, and hope the public's attention moves elsewhere.

The "Stop Nick Shirley Act" represents more than just bad policy. It's a confession written in legalese--a tacit admission that the state's governmental apparatus has become so corrupt, so entangled with fraudulent contractors and phantom service providers, that transparency itself has become an existential threat. California isn't just failing to honor its journalistic heritage; it's actively betraying it, substituting the Mark Twain Award's celebration of truth for a legislative gag order.

There was a time when California led the nation in sunshine laws, in open government, in that peculiarly American faith that sunlight is the best disinfectant. That California is gone now, replaced by something darker and smaller--a state so afraid of its own reflection that it would criminalize the mirror. The Mark Twain Awards still sit in their cases, gathering dust, testifying mutely to a standard that California's current leaders have chosen to abandon. What a pity. What a waste. What a tragedy for the republic that California once aspired to be.

* * *
We are witnessing a perfect example of everything that is broken in Donald Trump's Washington.
What happened this weekend at the White House Correspondents' Dinner--no matter how you feel about it--could have been an opportunity to start a real conversation about gun violence in America. It could have been a moment to talk about mental health, loneliness, and isolation among young men or even to have a legitimate discussion about political violence and rhetoric in this country and where it comes from--instead of the same bullshit gotcha game MAGA world always wants to play.
But every MAGA influencer, every Republican politician, and every member of the Trump White House grabbed whatever sliver of sympathy or political capital they could and immediately pivoted to pushing for the stupid ballroom Donald Trump has been obsessed with building.
Within moments--before people even understood what had actually happened--the talking points went out. In unison, they started promoting that this ballroom was somehow necessary to prevent incidents like this in the future.
There's no real logic behind that. Even if the ballroom existed, the president of the United States would still attend events outside the White House. He can't spend four years hiding in a bunker--though given his approval rating maybe that's a good idea. And yet, within 48 hours, Republican politicians and talking heads fell in line, echoing the same demand: build the ballroom.
Now members of Congress are introducing legislation to force and fund it. This is the same project that was supposedly going to be paid for privately. First, Trump said he'd fund it himself. Then it was going to be covered by private donations--which quickly started to look like a convenient way for wealthy donors to buy access, favors, or pardons. And now? Now they want you to pay for it.
Look at how fast they move when it's something he wants. Look at the urgency, the coordination, the willingness to act. And then ask yourself: where is that energy when it comes to literally anything that might improve your life?
There are no new ideas here. No plan to make things more affordable. No serious attempt to address the economic pressure people are under. They're disconnected from the day-to-day reality most Americans are dealing with.
Trump was elected on a promise centered on two things: lowering costs so people could afford to live with some stability and dignity and keeping the country out of another endless, pointless war. That was the pitch, as much as many of us know it was a dirty rotten lie. And he's failed on both counts.
People were already struggling before he took office. The economy under Joe Biden wasn't working for a lot of Americans--things were too expensive, and while the reasons were complicated, the frustration was real. There was an opening to do better.
Instead, things are getting worse.
Costs are rising across the board--gas, groceries, housing--and wages aren't keeping up. The job market feels increasingly unstable. And through all of it, Trump either has no answer or refuses to acknowledge the problem at all, insisting we're living in some "golden age."
If this were actually a golden age--if people could afford homes, support their families, and plan for the future--maybe they'd have the patience for vanity projects. Maybe then you could sell a ballroom or a grand monument or whatever symbolic project comes next.
But that's not the reality people are living in.
What they see instead is a president focused on himself. They see wealth accumulating at the top. They see influence being traded for favors. They see the same class of powerful people continuing to operate by a different set of rules. And they see their own situation getting more difficult by the month.
So the question becomes, who is any of this actually for?
Because it's clearly not for the people sitting at home wondering how they're going to make it all work.
* * *

Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/cea16462-315f-46db-863d-0da3a072830e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
This speaks to something much bigger. Time and again, Trump uses moments like this--moments that could lead to reflection, accountability, or even progress--as opportunities to capitalize, deflect, and benefit personally or politically. It's not an exception; it's a pattern. And in many ways, it defines his administration.
The lack of progress isn't just about age or policy--it's a question of character. Leadership at this level requires discernment, empathy, and pragmatism. It requires the ability to pause, reflect, and understand the weight of a moment before exploiting it. That simply isn't happening here.
And without those qualities, meaningful governance becomes impossible. Decisions stop being about improving people's lives and instead revolve around self-interest. You can't meaningfully do both--serve the public and prioritize personal gain. One will always come at the expense of the other, and it's increasingly clear which one is winning out.
Empathy matters because it's often what drives real change. When you've experienced hardship--or taken the time to truly understand it--you approach problems differently. You recognize the stakes and the urgency. That perspective shapes better, more grounded solutions.
But when that understanding is absent, so is the ability to see beyond your own vantage point. Lived experience informs how people engage with policy and with each other. Without that connection, leadership becomes detached--unable or unwilling to respond to the realities most people are actually facing.
More fundamentally, this goes beyond a single moment or decision: he's simply unqualified. Strip away the wealth and name recognition, and there's nothing in his background that suggests he's prepared to lead anything, let along the United States government. He lacks institutional knowledge, has little understanding of how government actually functions, and no experience operating within systems that require accountability or constraint.
That gap shows up in how he governs. The presidency requires discipline, awareness, and the ability to work within institutions--understanding their limits, respecting their roles, and navigating complexity without reducing everything to personal leverage or control. That kind of grounding is missing.
And when you combine that lack of preparation with the absence of empathy and reflection, you end up with a president that isn't just ineffective but ultimately unequipped for the role.
You can criticize the Democratic Party--and there's plenty to criticize. It's a flawed institution that hasn't met the moment in a lot of ways. But at minimum, there are people within it trying to improve your life.
This administration is not serious. They aren't even trying. They're just reactive, self-serving, and completely disconnected from what most people actually need.
At some point, this stops being about what he is or isn't doing and becomes about whether we're willing to raise the standard for what comes next when Trump is inevitable gone.
