Dear Friends and Neighbors,
I just wanted to open by expressing my heartfelt gratitude to everyone for the kind words, prayers, and support following the passing of my father, James McArthur Alsobrooks. My father sacrificed endlessly for my sister and me and spared no resource - time or otherwise - to provide us opportunities he never had. Always selfless. Always teaching life lessons in his unique way. Always uplifting, telling us we could do anything in this life. I'm heartbroken that we've lost a devoted husband, loving grandfather, and the best father I could ever dream of having. But I am forever grateful that he passed on the kind of wisdom that endures, and the memories that will never fade. While this has been a difficult time for our family, the love shown by so many Marylanders has certainly provided some comfort. On behalf of my family, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you.

You can read more about his amazing life in this article written by the [Baltimore Banner](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.thebanner.com%2fobituaries%2fangela-alsobrooks-father-james-mack-obituary-CK4AKIDU5FBR5CHY6NSW5OJDMU%2f&redir_log=26492326979718).
\----------------

We've had a busy couple of weeks here in Washington and across the state, so let's get into it.

Last week I questioned RFK Jr. during the Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee's "Hearing on Fiscal Year 2027 Department of Health and Human Services Budget." During a recent House Ways and Means Committee hearing, Rep. Terri Sewell (Ala.-07) questioned Health and Human Services Secretary RFK Jr. about his previous comments stating, _" Every Black kid is now just standard put on Adderall, SSRIs, benzos, which are known to induce violence. And those kids are going to have a chance to go somewhere and get re-parented -- to live in a community where there'll be no cellphones, no screens."_ He denied ever saying it, when questioned by Rep. Sewell.

Even more galling, a week later, with time to prepare for the question, Secretary Kennedy still denied saying it when I questioned him, and I confronted him with a transcript and recording.

Below is one of our exchanges:

_**Senator Alsobrooks**_ : _My next question. Now, you 've had some trouble with the truth. I've seen it myself during your appearances before Congress. We all saw during your exchange last week with Congresswoman Sewell. Can you admit today that you said every Black kid can get re-parented on a wellness farm? Can you admit that you said that? _

_**RFK Jr.**_ : _Get re-parented on a wellness farm? _

_**Senator Alsobrooks**_ :_Well, let me read exactly what you said, you said, "Every Black kid is now just standard put on Adderall, SSRIs, benzos, which are known to induce violence. And those kids are going to have a chance to go somewhere and get re-parented -- to live in a community where there'll be no cellphones, no screens." _
_ _
_The whole transcript was even worse. You said that if you could, you would send every Black kid, your words not mine, to go live on farms and work. _
_ _
_**RFK Jr.** : I would have to hear that recording. Because I have no memory of saying anything like that. _
_ _
_**Senator Alsobrooks** : Well, I actually have the recording that I can give to you. But it is absolutely what you said. And if you want me to play it, I can play it. _
_ _
_**RFK Jr.** : If you ask me what my opinion is, I do not believe that every Black kid should be re-parented on a wellness farm or whatever, and I have never believed that. _
_ _
_**Senator Alsobrooks** : Well, you said it, sir. I have the video here. _
_ _
_**RFK Jr.** : I'm telling you I don't believe it. That's not my vision for our country. _
_ _
_**Senator Alsobrooks** : Well, I'm glad because it was ignorant to say. It was dangerous and it was irresponsible. _
_ _
_**RFK Jr.** : Well, if I said it, I apologize, but I'd have to see the transcript. _
_ _
_ _
I also questioned RFK Jr. on the role of his friend and close associate, Aaron Siri, an anti-vaccine advocate and lawyer who has been working to push RFK Jr. to pave the way for HHS to falsely connect vaccines with autism and reduce access to life-saving vaccines for American children. When questioned, RFK Jr. couldn't answer who is actually deciding policies at HHS - the White House or Aaron Siri.

Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.youtube.com%2fwatch%3fv%3dBqXVbqm9qUg&redir_log=273286476766299) to see the entire line of questioning.

The bottom line is that each encounter that I've had with Secretary Kennedy is probably more disturbing than the one before it. You saw it with your own eyes. It was ignorant. It was disturbing. And it is, again, the reason why I was the first person to say last year that he was wholly unqualified for the position that he is in, and that he needed to resign or be fired.

You can [also see my full interview](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fyoutu.be%2fS7kdnhQyxtA&redir_log=756225946298195) on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell, where we discuss my questioning of RFK Jr. **Fighting Through Legislation ** It has been a busy few weeks here on Capitol Hill. From protecting vote by mail to making college tuition more affordable to making it easier for rural communities to apply for federal grants, I have been fighting hard for you on the floor of the Senate to push legislation that uplifts Maryland families:

Absentee and Mail Voter Protection Act: This bill would nullify President Trump's unlawful March 31 executive order (EO) that aims to illegally re-write federal election rules or any similar order and prohibit the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and any other agency from spending funds to implement actions in the President's unconstitutional executive order.

Senior Hunger Prevention Act: This bill would amend the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 to streamline access to nutrition for older adults and adults with disabilities, and for other purposes.

Restoring College Access and Affordability Act: This bill would reinstate student loan programs and borrower protections, making higher education more affordable and accessible to more Americans.

Fair Wages for Home Care Workers Act: This bill would ensure that home care employees are no longer exempted from overtime and minimum wage protections as established by the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938.

Floodplain Enhancement and Recovery Act: This bill would introduce provisions to support ecosystem restoration projects by defining such projects as those aimed at restoring or enhancing the natural functions of aquatic resources or floodplains. It exempts these projects from fees associated with flood insurance rate map changes.

EDA Short Form Application Act: This bill would require the Economic Development Administration (EDA) to work with leaders in rural communities to streamline and simplify the grant application process.

African American History Act: This bill would authorize the Director of the National Museum of African American History and Culture to carry out and expand African American history education programs, including digital resources, exhibitions, research, teacher training, and curriculum support in partnership with schools. The bill also requires annual reporting to Congress and authorizes four million dollars annually for five years to support these efforts.

Healthy Families Act: This bill would allow workers to earn up to seven paid sick days per year. Currently, there is no protection that guarantees workers' job-protected paid sick leave. The bill would allow employees to use this sick leave to recover from their own illnesses, access preventative care, care for a sick family member, or attend school meetings related to a child's health condition or disability. It would also allow workers who are victims of domestic violence, stalking, or sexual assault to use their days to recover or seek assistance related to the incident.

BE HEARD in the Workplace Act: The Bringing an End to Harassment by Enhancing Accountability and Rejecting Discrimination (BE HEARD) in the Workplace Act would take critical steps to prevent workplace harassment and ensure workers can seek accountability and justice. The bill would require reporting on the prevalence of workplace harassment and make anti-harassment trainings more accessible. It would end mandatory arbitration and pre-employment NDAs, which enable predators and discourage workers from coming forward. It would strengthen existing civil rights laws by expanding protections for workers and clarifying the Civil Rights Act to protect against discrimination in the workplace based on sexual orientation and gender identity. It would also authorize grants to support victims with low incomes. Finally, it would eliminate the tipped minimum wage, because tipped workers are disproportionately vulnerable to sexual harassment and discrimination by both clients and supervisors

FAIR Act: This bill would provide federal employees with a 4.3% raise in calendar year 2026. This includes 3.3% raises under the statutory pay systems and for prevailing rate employees, and a 1% increase to locality pay.

Regional Ocean Partnerships Reauthorization Act of 2026: This bill would reauthorize the Regional Ocean Partnership Act (ROPA) through Fiscal Year 2031.

Ally's Act: This bipartisan bill would mandate that private insurance companies cover hearing devices and related services, specifically cochlear implants and osseointegrated devices (bone-anchored hearing aids), for children and adults.

A resolution designating March 5, 2026, as "National Slam the Scam Day" to raise awareness about pervasive scams and to prevent government imposter scams and other types of scams by promoting education about such scams. (Agreed to in the Senate!)

A resolution expressing the sense of the Senate that the President should prioritize securing the release of Pastor Jin Mingri, Pastor Gao Quanfu and his wife Pang Yu, Dr. Gulshan Abbas, and Jimmy Lai detained by the People's Republic of China during future engagements with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

A resolution commending Taiwan on the 30th anniversary of its first direct presidential election in 1996, and expressing support for Taiwan in the preservation of its democratic institutions.

**In the Community **
I joined the Columbia (MD) Alumnae Chapter of Delta Sigma Theta for their Inaugural Women's Leadership Luncheon. Leadership isn't about titles, it's about vision and impact. When women lead, we lift communities, drive change, and create opportunities for others to rise with us.

I always have a great time meeting with students from across Maryland. I had a meaningful conversation with students from Towson University and encouraged them to give back to their communities and get involved in civil service. Their voices and talents are needed now more than ever.

I'm grateful to the Maryland African Chamber of Commerce and Vincent Iweanoge for the invitation to celebrate African diaspora women who power our communities. When we rise together, we all rise.

Investing in prevention works. Team Maryland secured $450,000 to support Bladensburg's new juvenile intervention program. Programs like this give young people constructive outlets, strong mentorship, and real opportunity.

I am proud to deliver real results for Greenbelt. Team Maryland is bringing home investments that expand opportunities for our kids, from after-school programs to a new roof at the Youth Center. When we invest in our young people, we are investing in our future.

I met with Maryland members of the Black Women's Roundtable. Hearing their struggle with rising tuition and a tough job market, worsened by this Administration, resonated with me, especially as the mother of a college student. We must do better for our children and students.

**Passport Acceptance Event **

I am so excited to announce that my office, in partnership with the U.S. Department of State's Washington Passport Agency, will be hosting a passport application acceptance fair at Greenbelt Branch Library on May 16!

With the summer months fast approaching, now is the perfect time to check your passport expiration date. Some countries require that your passport be valid for at least six months beyond the dates of your planned trip. So, whether your passport is expiring, has expired, or you're applying for the first time, you can come to our fair - by appointment only - get all of your questions answered, and all of your paperwork submitted.

Only one registered appointment holder per family (up to seven people total per appointment) is required. Passports will be sent by mail within 4-6 weeks (routine service) or 2-3 weeks (expedited service).

To make an appointment, click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fticketbud.com%2fevents%2fa0f93872-3907-11f1-9d3b-42010a71700b&redir_log=571468895032379) or scan the QR code in the flyer below.

What to bring: \- Appointment Confirmation - Bring your Ticketbud appointment confirmation email.

- A Completed Passport Application - follow the steps for [first-time applications](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fneed-passport%2fapply-in-person.html&redir_log=421654948765617) (Form DS-11) or [renewal applications](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fhave-passport%2frenew.html&redir_log=649706096326548) (Form DS-82).

\- [Evidence of your U.S. Citizenship](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fhow-apply%2fcitizenship-evidence.html&redir_log=411605894783626) - Birth Certificate; Certificate of Naturalization or Citizenship; Previously Issued U.S. Passport.

\- [A Recent Passport Photo](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fhow-apply%2fphotos.html&redir_log=254682292676527) - 2" x 2" (NO GLASSES in Passport Photos). _**Note: photo services will not be available at the passport fair.**_

\- [Valid Photo Identification](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fhow-apply%2fidentification.html&redir_log=731134795843584) - Driver's License; State ID Card; current passport; or Military ID. Also, provide a clear, single-sided copy of the front and back of the ID.

\- [Passport Fee Payment](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15387.17980222.6106750.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftravel.state.gov%2fcontent%2ftravel%2fen%2fpassports%2fhow-apply%2ffees.html&redir_log=888713347843509) - check, money order, or credit card, **but no cash**.

clean_body: | Dear Friends and Neighbors, I just wanted to open by expressing my heartfelt gratitude to everyone for the kind words, prayers, and support following the passing of my father, James McArthur Alsobrooks. My father sacrificed endlessly for my sister and me and spared no resource - time or otherwise - to provide us opportunities he never had. Always selfless. Always teaching life lessons in his unique way. Always uplifting, telling us we could do anything in this life. I'm heartbroken that we've lost a devoted husband, loving grandfather, and the best father I could ever dream of having. But I am forever grateful that he passed on the kind of wisdom that endures, and the memories that will never fade. While this has been a difficult time for our family, the love shown by so many Marylanders has certainly provided some comfort. On behalf of my family, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you. You can read more about his amazing life in this article written by the . \---------------- We've had a busy couple of weeks here in Washington and across the state, so let's get into it. Last week I questioned RFK Jr. during the Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee's "Hearing on Fiscal Year 2027 Department of Health and Human Services Budget." During a recent House Ways and Means Committee hearing, Rep. Terri Sewell (Ala.-07) questioned Health and Human Services Secretary RFK Jr. about his previous comments stating, " Every Black kid is now just standard put on Adderall, SSRIs, benzos, which are known to induce violence. And those kids are going to have a chance to go somewhere and get re-parented -- to live in a community where there'll be no cellphones, no screens." He denied ever saying it, when questioned by Rep. Sewell. Even more galling, a week later, with time to prepare for the question, Secretary Kennedy still denied saying it when I questioned him, and I confronted him with a transcript and recording. Below is one of our exchanges: Senator Alsobrooks : My next question. Now, you 've had some trouble with the truth. I've seen it myself during your appearances before Congress. We all saw during your exchange last week with Congresswoman Sewell. Can you admit today that you said every Black kid can get re-parented on a wellness farm? Can you admit that you said that? RFK Jr. : Get re-parented on a wellness farm? Senator Alsobrooks :Well, let me read exactly what you said, you said, "Every Black kid is now just standard put on Adderall, SSRIs, benzos, which are known to induce violence. And those kids are going to have a chance to go somewhere and get re-parented -- to live in a community where there'll be no cellphones, no screens." The whole transcript was even worse. You said that if you could, you would send every Black kid, your words not mine, to go live on farms and work. RFK Jr. : I would have to hear that recording. Because I have no memory of saying anything like that. Senator Alsobrooks : Well, I actually have the recording that I can give to you. But it is absolutely what you said. And if you want me to play it, I can play it. RFK Jr. : If you ask me what my opinion is, I do not believe that every Black kid should be re-parented on a wellness farm or whatever, and I have never believed that. Senator Alsobrooks : Well, you said it, sir. I have the video here. RFK Jr. : I'm telling you I don't believe it. That's not my vision for our country. Senator Alsobrooks : Well, I'm glad because it was ignorant to say. It was dangerous and it was irresponsible. RFK Jr. : Well, if I said it, I apologize, but I'd have to see the transcript. I also questioned RFK Jr. on the role of his friend and close associate, Aaron Siri, an anti-vaccine advocate and lawyer who has been working to push RFK Jr. to pave the way for HHS to falsely connect vaccines with autism and reduce access to life-saving vaccines for American children. When questioned, RFK Jr. couldn't answer who is actually deciding policies at HHS - the White House or Aaron Siri. Click to see the entire line of questioning. The bottom line is that each encounter that I've had with Secretary Kennedy is probably more disturbing than the one before it. You saw it with your own eyes. It was ignorant. It was disturbing. And it is, again, the reason why I was the first person to say last year that he was wholly unqualified for the position that he is in, and that he needed to resign or be fired. You can on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell, where we discuss my questioning of RFK Jr. Fighting Through Legislation It has been a busy few weeks here on Capitol Hill. From protecting vote by mail to making college tuition more affordable to making it easier for rural communities to apply for federal grants, I have been fighting hard for you on the floor of the Senate to push legislation that uplifts Maryland families: Absentee and Mail Voter Protection Act: This bill would nullify President Trump's unlawful March 31 executive order (EO) that aims to illegally re-write federal election rules or any similar order and prohibit the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and any other agency from spending funds to implement actions in the President's unconstitutional executive order. Senior Hunger Prevention Act: This bill would amend the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 to streamline access to nutrition for older adults and adults with disabilities, and for other purposes. Restoring College Access and Affordability Act: This bill would reinstate student loan programs and borrower protections, making higher education more affordable and accessible to more Americans. Fair Wages for Home Care Workers Act: This bill would ensure that home care employees are no longer exempted from overtime and minimum wage protections as established by the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938. Floodplain Enhancement and Recovery Act: This bill would introduce provisions to support ecosystem restoration projects by defining such projects as those aimed at restoring or enhancing the natural functions of aquatic resources or floodplains. It exempts these projects from fees associated with flood insurance rate map changes. EDA Short Form Application Act: This bill would require the Economic Development Administration (EDA) to work with leaders in rural communities to streamline and simplify the grant application process. African American History Act: This bill would authorize the Director of the National Museum of African American History and Culture to carry out and expand African American history education programs, including digital resources, exhibitions, research, teacher training, and curriculum support in partnership with schools. The bill also requires annual reporting to Congress and authorizes four million dollars annually for five years to support these efforts. Healthy Families Act: This bill would allow workers to earn up to seven paid sick days per year. Currently, there is no protection that guarantees workers' job-protected paid sick leave. The bill would allow employees to use this sick leave to recover from their own illnesses, access preventative care, care for a sick family member, or attend school meetings related to a child's health condition or disability. It would also allow workers who are victims of domestic violence, stalking, or sexual assault to use their days to recover or seek assistance related to the incident. BE HEARD in the Workplace Act: The Bringing an End to Harassment by Enhancing Accountability and Rejecting Discrimination (BE HEARD) in the Workplace Act would take critical steps to prevent workplace harassment and ensure workers can seek accountability and justice. The bill would require reporting on the prevalence of workplace harassment and make anti-harassment trainings more accessible. It would end mandatory arbitration and pre-employment NDAs, which enable predators and discourage workers from coming forward. It would strengthen existing civil rights laws by expanding protections for workers and clarifying the Civil Rights Act to protect against discrimination in the workplace based on sexual orientation and gender identity. It would also authorize grants to support victims with low incomes. Finally, it would eliminate the tipped minimum wage, because tipped workers are disproportionately vulnerable to sexual harassment and discrimination by both clients and supervisors FAIR Act: This bill would provide federal employees with a 4.3% raise in calendar year 2026. This includes 3.3% raises under the statutory pay systems and for prevailing rate employees, and a 1% increase to locality pay. Regional Ocean Partnerships Reauthorization Act of 2026: This bill would reauthorize the Regional Ocean Partnership Act (ROPA) through Fiscal Year 2031. Ally's Act: This bipartisan bill would mandate that private insurance companies cover hearing devices and related services, specifically cochlear implants and osseointegrated devices (bone-anchored hearing aids), for children and adults. A resolution designating March 5, 2026, as "National Slam the Scam Day" to raise awareness about pervasive scams and to prevent government imposter scams and other types of scams by promoting education about such scams. Here's the thing: I don't believe I'll win this race in spite of Republican voters in East Tennessee.
**I think I 'll win this race because we are creating a coalition of folks who see and feel the brokenness of our system and want to fix it together.**
We will succeed by creating a movement where we can have tough conversations about what ails us and creating solutions together.
We might disagree on some policies, but we want to go in the same direction. We want the people of East Tennessee to be able to afford to live here. We want clean air and water for this generation and the next. We want a healthcare system that provides quality care and doesn't bankrupt us in the process. We want solid roads and bridges and schools. We want hard work to put you ahead, not keep you struggling. We want public servants, not professional grifters.
If you voted for Donald Trump and Tim Burchett but are starting to think you were sold a false bill of goods - you're welcome in this movement.
Some folks are excited when they hear that I have Trump and Burchett voters supporting my campaign. Other folks get nervous, which I understand. They don't want another politician doing napkin math about electability to pick what they believe in and shifting their values when poll numbers or focus groups suggest it might help them win a few more votes.
That kind of calculus is what got us into this mess.
Let me be clear: I haven't changed my values, what I'm fighting for, or my assessment of the problems that got us here.
I believe trickle-down economics has failed East Tennessee.
I think gutting healthcare to fund tax cuts for the wealthy and calling it fiscal responsibility is a scam.
I know that prioritizing corporation's profits above everything else - above our workers, our environment, our access to care - has caused generational harm.
And I think we can all agree that stoking division - hating your neighbor, fearing who someone loves, rejecting someone because of where they come from - is a tool to keep us outraged while our pockets get picked.
I haven't changed my values. I'm not going to bait and switch you like John Fetterman.
So why did we get Republicans for Michaela signs printed? Because we have Republicans joining this campaign every week, many of whom voted for Burchett and Trump.
**I am more interested in fixing the big problems we face rather than litigating blame with voters. That doesn 't mean I won't fight for accountability for what this administration has done. I will. **
**It does mean that I 'm clear on who I'm fighting, and who I'm fighting for.**
I am fighting against our leaders who are failing us. Donald Trump with his agenda of chaos and cruelty while robbing us blind, and Tim Burchett who enables and cheers him on while the people of East Tennessee suffer. I am fighting for my neighbors here in Tennessee's 2nd Congressional District, no matter their political party or voting history.
Voters' economic anxiety is real. The fear of being left behind is real. The feeling that Washington has abandoned places like ours is real.
We have diabetics rationing insulin and mothers that have to drive over an hour to get prenatal care and give birth. Infrastructure needs with no funding source. Veterans fighting for their benefits every month. Young people leaving East Tennessee because they can't afford a future here. Our tax dollars (and yet more borrowed money that leaves future generations with one more bill to pay) funding more foreign wars while we're told there's no money for what we need here at home.
**If you want someone who will work to solve these problems, not just complain about how hard it is to get stuff done in DC, you belong in this movement.**
If you're a:
* Lifelong Republican who no longer recognizes your party's leadership or priorities
* A 3x Trump voter asking yourself hard questions about what comes next
* An Independent demanding representation outside of our broken 2 party system
* Someone who has never voted at all, because you didn't believe that anyone was going to fight for your community
* A progressive tired of Democratic leadership that responds to existential threats with strongly worded letters and takes money from the same corporations we're asking them to hold in check
* Or a Democrat proud of what our party has fought for and accomplished over the years who knows we're not done fighting for progress

You're welcome in this movement.
So why do we have Republicans for Michaela yard signs? I made them not in spite of my values, but because of them.
- Michaela

| | Dear Friend,

In the spring of 1775, a handful of farmers and tradesmen stood their ground against the greatest military power on earth.

They didn't know how the story would end.

But they knew that freedom was worth fighting for.

The "shot heard 'round the world" set in motion a chain of events that led to the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.

That's why I'm excited to share something special with you.

**The White House recently asked Hillsdale College to assist the Salute to America 250 Task Force in producing a new free video series, [_The Story of America_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/lPL-sJh76qezCJbuuxU8wtiVU2oDCwBi0lI3NVNCSy0pzA_KwKp4JNw30jShzbJ8AJ_RUzQ_j-ZWfS1eupYKsnwDnmpphtukzzXK_sAn2WBwrOoj_YGqvUSfBVmvjR9JXxPsljmes9iKkxRYgsIoYAJLiQr3XYviO5w_QxxpeFb_M-EaafXNtBxeqf3AS07HQJXIBF2Tc6oDp0miq-klCeBatBcqDQ2ReFkxYsvy1891BFNpJhOArTfxB--8g3SxeVh_eabD7-Szt4We6lbnBXSTEo_KxP8c5_QaHoCDyvlQt32qvid7NoO0TCBUDuT_tnRBrv0rC2nBtPrmrOnWD_TeWeYV2iLPuwnnsuxbftcvxls0kfwTc7p56R6Kf9zGK3brUmWjOf61AyovyKNOEl87Xv9UaDYWptwX-TbTfBsBxs30OML-tj5Yuuo8zUDYR2PopuvkuXSDG1hgXFXP5FRjsWIkQW5BJpRRBbuhpEx3yHM0ZLNVBk2-5TipZp6TLmpEzdtyRXGynNyp0HUZfqpW6ZvULBsAVJ5ULQVtZ05lLONYWY6f4Mz1KYVo325DEjf7I-sRSZ0Ksf5zdyGgIi1TlWrqWRZ0pKblVJWN4nPp13w2URmL3CdpxWiuF5JLyfbFASqAYNkGBKAMqGdfwWgaybmOG2VWSy3bo7tlp1_UAVgbH_hg5QbHPvoGOSBbVO8WfwWEtOFJUT_n6PrSxqJlt2Js/Q9drznWxO9GEeRhgmPveVzUnl6L6jgXP/20)** --a sweeping, episode-by-episode journey through our nation's founding in honor of its 250th anniversary.

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, this series invites you to learn about the principles, courage, sacrifice, and faith that made America possible--and _why this story still matters today_.

Filmed in the historic Indian Treaty Room in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in Washington, D.C., each episode brings a pivotal chapter of the American story to life.

**Here 's a glimpse of what you can access on your journey at no cost:****
**

* **The Declaration of Independence** -- _Larry P. Arnn, President, Hillsdale College_
How the Declaration of Independence defines who we are--and what it still asks of us

* **The Formation of the Army** -- _Pete Hegseth, Secretary of War_
The moment citizen-patriots took up arms and answered liberty's call against overwhelming odds

* **The King 's Call to Arms** -- _U.S. Senator Mike Lee_
When imperial authority collided with colonial defiance--and compromise was no longer possible

* **The Culper Spy Ring** -- _Brian Kilmeade, Co-Author, George Washington 's Secret Six_
The remarkable story of ordinary Americans who risked everything to outsmart the British and save the Revolution

* **Story of the American Soldier** -- _Michael Knowles, Author and Podcaster_
A tribute to the forgotten men whose sacrifice secured American independence

* **The U.S. Marine Corps Birthday** -- _Vice President J.D. Vance_

I’ve brought that same patient-first approach to Congress for the past 13 years. I am tirelessly working day in and day out to lower health care costs, protect your access to care, and stand up for evidence-based public health policies. As I run in a new district this year, I need your help to ensure we can run a strong campaign. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately by pressing a button below. = = = = = It has been enraging for me to watch this administration’s attempts to move us backward on important matters of public health. The latest move by Secretary Hegseth to eliminate the flu vaccine requirement for our troops is completely reckless and puts the health of our troops at risk. Our federal government should be focused on lowering costs and making life more affordable for Americans, not starting pointless wars abroad or pursuing policies that will make our troops sicker and less prepared to keep us safe. I believe leadership should be about solving problems, not creating new ones — and the Trump administration is failing that basic test. It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

| | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like:
---
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever.

* Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars.

* Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

clean_body: The biggest National Memorial Day Parade yet | | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Patriot, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. body:
| |
---
Hi friend — I want to give you a quick update on where this campaign has been lately. Over the past few weeks, I have been to house parties, community events, and neighborhood meetups all across Rhode Island. We’ve visited living rooms in North Kingstown, Barrington, Warren, Providence, a distillery in Pawtucket, a winery in Newport, a historic pub in Woonsocket, and so many coffee shops, kitchen tables, and front porches from the top of the state to the bottom (and the islands in the middle).
---
|
---
| | [ **CHIP IN TO KEEP US GOING** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/mpfOqny0WpJz)
---
Now, I know what you might be thinking if you’re a Rhode Islander: _“Sue... some of those are kind of far. Do you pack a snack?”_ And I hear you. I truly do. As Rhode Islanders, we know that anything more than 20 minutes away is a genuine expedition. Cross a bridge? Into another state entirely as far as we’re concerned. 😄 But that’s kind of the whole point. I’ve spent years on the Providence City Council working for the people of Ward 3. I know every bench in Lippitt Park and every square inch of North Main Street. I love that work. I’m proud of what we built together. But there are people across Rhode Island — in every corner of this amazing state — who need a Lieutenant Governor who shows up for them the same way I show up for my neighbors in Ward 3. So I’m showing up everywhere, **but I need your help to keep doing it.**
---
| **🎯 End-of-Month Goal:
$6,500 more raised +
250 new grassroots donors
By April 30th**

Every dollar and every donor helps power the house parties, the canvasses, the interns, and the statewide infrastructure this campaign needs to keep going.

**[If you can chip in, even $10 or $25, you’re directly supporting our ability to keep showing up in every part of Rhode Island. Which is the whole strategy. Help power the statewide tour with a donation today →](https://sue4ri.com/l/V65stA4YiJYH)** If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | [ **DONATE $10** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/90R1mUHoMrQm)
---
| [ **DONATE $25** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/lh2rTSKck8gi)
---
| [ **DONATE OTHER** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/Ty0x2aAgrchh)
---
All of this — the house parties, the events, the canvasses we’re ramping up in May — it costs money. Not a lot per event. [**But it adds up, and we’re trying to raise an additional $6,500 and bring in 250 new grassroots donors before the end of the month. Can you help?**](https://sue4ri.com/l/DQuJXwFwxyxS) Thank you for being part of this. With gratitude, Sue
---
| | Join Sue's journey to build a government that isn’t afraid to take on big challenges, that has your back, and will take responsibility for fixing things that are broken.

[ **[Donate today to support a candidate who will have a major impact for good in Rhode Island.](https://sue4ri.com/l/yJDxaMSfhAAp)** ](https://sue4ri.com/l/h8Svde4rMGbO)

body:
#
This past weekend, I visited Boston and I meant every word that I said: **our movement needs Ayanna Pressley now more than ever**.
Now is the moment for us to show up for our neighbors, and build a more just world one small act at a time. From Ayanna’s successful, strategic legislative effort to force a vote to protect Haiti TPS holders, to daily acts of mutual aid, it’s all a critical part of sustaining this progressive movement.
From taking someone to the airport, to watching their kids, to offering a meal — each small act is a political act of solidarity.
**Ayanna is showing up because she cares for the people of her district and working families across the country. She has the clear resolve for governing with love and solidarity that we need a lot more of in Congress**.
Sustaining our movement is a marathon — not a sprint — and we need supporters like you to pitch in what you can, when you can, to keep our movement strong.
[I’m in this fight with Ayanna all the way — and our campaigns are both 100% powered by the people. subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/28/2026
body:
Trump’s DOJ joins xAI suit against Colorado AI law as Weiser agrees to halt enforcement
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hey friends,
Another big announcement coming this week 👀 We’re revealing another major speaker for Freedom Fest—make sure you’re on the [priority list](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to be the first to know when it drops. [And get your tickets here!](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). And don't miss our [deep-dive video on HB 26-1250](https://link.email.joinrmv.), a major debate over property rights. Here is a summary of today's top stories:

**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** With 15 days left in session—unless extended—debate is intensifying over [government authority and transparency](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while lawmakers weigh a bipartisan bill [requiring a criminal conviction before permanent property seizure](https://link.email.joinrmv.), drawing support on due process grounds and opposition from law enforcement.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** State actions face scrutiny after a behavioral health hiring lapse involving a [$99,000 fraud case prompted a review](https://link.email.joinrmv.), as [crowded 2026 primaries](https://link.email.joinrmv.) take shape with term limits opening key offices. Meanwhile, a [coal plant remains online](https://link.email.joinrmv.) under federal grid orders, and counties push back on [unfunded landfill mandates](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Investigators say a suspect in a White House Correspondents’ Dinner shooting [sent a manifesto targeting officials](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while the DOJ joins a [major lawsuit over Colorado’s AI law](https://link.email.joinrmv.) raising constitutional concerns. Separately, a federal indictment is spotlighting allegations the Southern Poverty Law Center may have [supported individuals tied to extremist activity](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, April 28, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Trump’s DOJ joins xAI suit against Colorado AI law as Weiser agrees to halt enforcement](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
The Colorado attorney general agreed last week to stop enforcing the state’s landmark artificial intelligence law. Not because a court told him to. Because he agreed to it himself.
That voluntary freeze, formalized in a joint filing with plaintiff xAI LLC, came the same afternoon the U.S. Department of Justice moved to join the lawsuit challenging SB24-205 — Colorado’s AI consumer protection law set to take effect June 30.
Chief Judge Daniel D. Domenico granted both the intervention and the standstill within hours. The scheduling conference set for June 16 is gone. Case deadlines are suspended. The courtroom is waiting on a legislature that has 16 days left in its session and a replacement bill that still hasn’t been formally introduced.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.**
Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds.
_America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._
Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[If the state can take property without a conviction, no property is safe](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Bill would require conviction before property seizure:** House Bill 1250 aims to close a loophole allowing permanent forfeiture without a criminal conviction, shifting toward a model that ties property loss to proven wrongdoing.
* **Current system allows forfeiture without proving a crime:** Colorado law permits property to be taken based on alleged connection to a crime, raising due process concerns since owners can lose assets without being convicted.
* **Debate highlights balance between enforcement and rights:** Supporters say reform protects constitutional rights and innocent owners, while opponents—including law enforcement groups—argue it could impact existing practices and funding tied to forfeiture.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Counties forced to pay: State landfill mandates come without funding](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Unfunded mandates shifting costs to local governments:** A state air quality rule requires costly methane controls at county landfills without providing funding, adding financial pressure on local communities.
* **Legislative effort to address cost burden weakened:** A bill aimed at making the state cover these mandates advanced out of committee but was significantly scaled back through amendments, reducing its impact.
* **Debate highlights role of unelected boards and rising costs:** The mandate originated from an appointed state commission, raising concerns about accountability and the broader impact on taxpayers as compliance costs are expected to increase.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[The empty pail: The first step up the mountain](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | APRIL 27** _“Jack and Jill went up the hill to fetch a pail of water...” Continuing with last devotion’s rhyme, we often remember the fall... but rarely ask the deeper question: What if they made it to the top... but never learned how to draw from the well? Because in the life of following Jesus, the issue is not whether we’ve started the climb—it’s whether we are being formed and becoming who we need to be as we go to do what God needs us to do._
__
**[Peters’ defense says Barrett used facts that were never in evidence](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | APRIL 24** _The state said Judge Matthew Barrett’s sentencing remarks about Tina Peters were harsh words from the bench, not evidence of bias. Peters’ legal team answered with a different question: how did the judge know she appeared on podcasts? Where did he get the words “snake oil” and “junk”?_
__
**[Take back Colorado starts local: Brandon Wark on the fight ahead](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY RMV STAFF | STATE | APRIL 24** _As another contentious session winds toward its May 13 close, a familiar question is surfacing among voters: Can the state’s direction actually be changed — and if so, how? In the latest episode of Unleashed, Heidi Ganahl sits down with Brandon Wark, founder of Free State Colorado and one of the most trusted voices covering the State Capitol, to unpack what just happened under the gold dome and what it means for 2026._ __

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).

Jane Fonda is one of the most tenacious human beings I have ever known. Trust me, fifty years of friendship tells you a whole lot about a person. So when I say that the work Jane is doing right now with her Climate PAC matters — _in a this-is-not-a-drill kind of way_ — I mean it. I’ve watched her fight for decades even if that fight sometimes ended with us in handcuffs. **[If you’re already feeling motivated, then I'd love for you to chip in a donation of any amount to Jane’s Climate PAC before Thursday at midnight. Jane’s team is working to reach $40,000 in grassroots online donations ahead of their end-of-month deadline. Every single donation from people like you sends a message to Big Oil and the entire fossil fuel industry: people are with us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130337266/617429262/2105508926?refcode=ea.806f0052-3443-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ms=ea.806f0052-3443-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwNmYwMDUyLTM0NDMtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=96lypHlTS7xpJxwud4xZDhdgKJ1GAeUukGwEsQuoiDA=)** Here's the truth: What’s happening in our country isn’t normal, and we can’t let ourselves forget that. An illegal war launched without congressional approval. A government that has decided corporate polluters matter more than the people breathing their poison. Democratic norms being dismantled faster than most people can track. _Business as usual is behind us._ And what comes next is shaped by the people who refuse to go along with it. Jane refuses. Her Climate PAC is doing the unglamorous, essential work of electing brave leaders from public utility boards to Congress who refuse right along with her — people who will fight for our planet, our democracy, and our fundamental freedoms every single time. **What many people don’t realize is that these fights are won long before Election Day. Early support helps candidates hire organizers, reach voters, and build the kind of campaign infrastructure it takes to compete with Big Oil and the other powerful interests trying to drown them out.** **[That’s what your support makes possible right now. So I’m asking: Can you help Jane’s team reach their $40,000 goal before Thursday night? | | | Fellow Conservative, Our latest fundraising numbers have me so worried that I immediately typed this letter to every single top grassroots conservative we have on file. _The situation is that desperate._ **You see, with the end-of-month deadline rapidly approaching, we're still thousands of dollars **_**SHORT**_** of our goal.** This goal isn't just some arbitrary number that I landed on. We need every last donor to compete with the BILLIONS that Democrats are spending to BUY the midterm elections. **_... Especially now that the Democrats are TIED or AHEAD in the four battleground races that they need to seize control of the Senate and SHATTER the final firewall protecting the President! _** **_New York Times: Why a Democratic Senate, Once Unthinkable, Is a Real Possibility_** **" ...Democrats are ****tied or ahead in ****four**** Republican-held seats****, polls show."** We're already fighting to catch up to the Democrats in the polls, in voter enthusiasm, and most importantly, in voter verifications... The last thing we can afford is to start falling behind in fundraising! As a top America First patriot, I knew I could count on you to read this emergency correspondence. Given all that you've already done for our country, I hate to ask you to do even more, but I have no choice... [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130338690/617431560/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOWI5N2Y4YS0zNjQzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cEoFgCvz25yT92b0dNZ_7ZnAFRuB996sljhUVzqXA58=&emci=3bbb89f8-1643-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=f9b97f8a-3643-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=15820338)

Peter,

When I first won this seat in 2018, it was historic. It was the first time a Democrat had ever been elected to represent WA-08.

Every election since has been another battle. Yet, every time, we've been able to win because this team showed up, stayed engaged, and made sure people knew the stakes.

**The circumstances of this year's midterms have only become more dire.**

Already, the GOP is recruiting aggressively and pouring resources into districts like ours. They're trying to protect their paper-thin, dwindling majority and expand it. Nothing is off the table for them: not silencing the voters, not rigging the maps, not pushing around dark money, and certainly not outright lying to the American people. This is not a district we can afford to take for granted. And it's not a cycle where things come together at the last minute.

These races are built day by day and month by month, through sustained work and the resources to match it. And with where we are right now, this election year feels different. When I ran in 2018, we were dealing with a dangerous Trump Administration, but what we're seeing now is even more extreme. This administration is forcing policies that ignore science, undermine public health, and chip away at the institutions that are supposed to protect people. And it's happening at a rapid pace, with every Republican Member of Congress rubber-stamping the agenda.

As a doctor, I've been fighting back, particularly against RFK Jr.'s anti-science agenda and the damage being done to agencies like the FDA and NIH. I've also sounded the alarm when this administration crosses lines that hurt the very people we're supposed to serve.

None of this work happens in isolation, Peter. I need your help securing the resources to keep this campaign strong and competitive in a district like WA-08. Your support right now helps ensure we're ready for whatever comes next, and it keeps us in the fight to defend this seat and win back the House.

| | **RITE Challenges Hennepin County’s Refusal to Produce Key Election Records**
_**Minnesota’s Largest County Ignored Request for Noncitizen Registration and Voting Records**_
**MINNEAPOLIS, MN** — Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), a nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting the rule of law in elections, has filed a [formal complaint](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=989c741d59&e=ea91f782ea) with the Minnesota Court of Administrative Hearings against Hennepin County Elections for its violation of the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act (MGDPA). Hennepin has failed to produce requested public records, including those related to noncitizen voting and its “vouching” system that allows for a registered voter to verify another voter’s residency.

The complaint follows months of noncompliance by Hennepin County, Minnesota’s largest county and home of Minneapolis, after RITE submitted a [detailed public records request](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4dc36667d3&e=ea91f782ea) on January 27, 2026. On the same day, RITE sent a substantively identical request to Ramsey County (St. Paul). Ramsey acknowledged the request and produced responsive records on February 11 that revealed the county had made multiple criminal referrals to local law enforcement for apparent noncitizen voting.

“This is not a close case,” said RITE President Justin Riemer. “Minnesota law requires transparency and prompt access to public records. Hennepin County simply ignored a lawful request for information critical to evaluate the integrity of Minnesota’s election processes. Ramsey County managed to comply quickly. For some reason, Hennepin County chose not to.”

RITE’s requested records related to voter registration processes, list maintenance, and communications with state officials, with a focus on identifying whether Minnesota’s election processes adequately prevent noncitizen registration and voting. The complaint alleges that the county’s failure to respond constitutes a clear violation of Minnesota law requiring prompt access to government data.

The complaint asks the Court of Administrative Hearings to find probable cause that Hennepin County violated the MGDPA and to order appropriate relief.

RITE continues to pursue transparency and accountability in election administration nationwide, ensuring that election officials comply with both federal and state law governing public access to election records. ###

I'm going to fight to protect our neighbors. Immigrants, women, and LGBTQ+ Californians are under assault from this administration. That ends when we flip this seat.
And I'm going to hold MAGA accountable. Not just with speeches — with votes, with investigations, with every tool available to a Member of Congress. The era of consequence-free MAGA corruption has to end somewhere. It can end here.

body:

Hi friend, It's Morghan, Nellie Pou's campaign manager. As we get closer to the midterm election, every day counts, especially in a race like ours. | This landmark case is part of an ongoing battle against Trump and his conservative allies’ efforts in the South and across the country to redraw congressional and legislative districts to deny Black and Brown voters meaningful representation. The strength and survival of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act is central to protecting communities of color from gerrymandering and at-large elections that dilute their voting power and rig the system.
Join us to:
* Learn about the legal history of _Louisiana v. Callais_ and know what's at stake,
* Understand what a ruling could mean for congressional representation and future elections,
* Gain an on-the-ground perspective on how Southern communities could be impacted,
* Stay informed on the pillars of the response strategy being built across the Southern states, and,
* Find out how you can get involved.

Team,
In 2018, I put my name on a ballot to challenge my State Senator, the Republican incumbent who had won his last race by **16 points**.
When I told some of my local Democratic party leadership that I wanted to challenge him, they said, “Oh honey, that’s _cute_. You don’t have a chance.”
But when all the votes were counted on election night, we beat that guy by **4 points.**

If anyone ever tells you an area is too red, or not worth fighting for: _That’s bullshit._
We can organize anywhere.
We can flip red seats.
We can even flip entire chambers.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026]
Derek,
It’s been 59 days since Donald Trump attacked Iran — without consulting Congress, without a plan, and without regard for the consequences.
Since then, American servicemembers have died, thousands of civilians have died, and Americans are increasingly fed up with the prospect of another endless Middle East war and skyrocketing gas prices here at home as a result.
So this month, I once again forced a vote on my Iran War Powers Resolution to bring an end to Donald Trump’s chaotic and unlawful war of choice in Iran. And once again, Senate Republicans blocked it.
Let’s be clear about what voting no on this resolution means: Republicans in the Senate have agreed to cede their constitutionally-given war powers to the president — for the fourth time.
A yes vote would have upheld our constitutional obligation to the men and women we send into harm's way: to make sure Congress authorizes the wars we ask them to fight. But once again, Republicans refused.
But here's what's different this time: the clock is running out on them.
Under the War Powers Act, Congress must authorize military force within 60 days of a conflict's start. That deadline is imminent.
The American people deserve to know where their leaders stand, and I will not stop forcing this fight until we end this foolish and expensive war against Iran.
I pray for the families who have already lost someone. And I pray this does not become another endless war.
Thank you for standing with me.
Tim Kaine

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, did you
know that Justice Democrats candidate Dr. Adam Hamawy is the doctor who
saved Senator Tammy Duckworth’s life?

helicopter was shot down in a mass casualty event. Though she was the most
seriously injured, Dr. Adam operated on her for hours and saved her life.

The two reconnected 20 years later in 2024, when Sen. Duckworth returned
the favor by helping Dr. Adam and his team of volunteers evacuate from
Gaza, where they provided lifesaving medical services to Palestinians.

After witnessing the horrific trauma inflicted on Palestinian children and
families by Israel’s genocide, and seeing too many congressional Democrats
support it, he decided to run for office to be a vote against AIPAC,
forever wars, and the corporate-backed establishment.

This Democratic primary is only about a month away, and we’re working
tirelessly to win so Dr. Adam can join the rest of our progressive,
working-class bloc in Congress. But naturally, AIPAC and other corporate
super PACs will spend whatever it takes to stop us — which is why we need

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042826_2&amount=25]
President Trump is trying everything his advisors can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042826_2&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042826_2&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042826_2&amount=35]

Friend,
**I'm proud to report that I've just earned an A rating from the National Rifle Association in my race for the U.S. Senate.**
What I can tell you is that rating isn't merely a letter grade given out to all Republicans.
It's a verdict on a record, built case by case, lawsuit by lawsuit, over four years as Kentucky's Attorney General, and I’m very proud of it.
I’m proud of it because I know the 2nd Amendment isn’t some leftover remnant of an earlier era, or proof of the political sway of hunters.
**The 2nd Amendment is our shield against tyranny. In a republic built upon the self-evident truth that** _**we are citizens, not subjects**_**, the right to self-defense and to keep and bear arms is as fundamental as our rights to speak freely and practice our faith.**
That’s why I fought back and won when Joe Biden and the Democrats tried to push through schemes like the backdoor tracking of firearm and ammunition purchases through credit card companies.
In Washington, D.C., we don’t need any more Republicans who’ll say the right things on Fox News but fold when the cameras go dark.
**We need a Senator who understands that our fundamental rights are not negotiable and will fight to protect them, whether it’s against liberal gun-grabbers, dark money groups or a wobbly GOP establishment looking to curry favor with the media.**
[**If you’ll stand with me in this fight, I could use your support by Thursday night. This is our FINAL month-end push before voters head to the polls on May 19th, and anything you can pitch in will make a real difference on the ground.**](https://eot.cameronforkentucky.com/f/a/9eoiPhHnzSA_xAqGOIWC-w~~/AAAHURA~/bZN9d7CRViN0WRPIxFgj9Jyh4qRcn7lIEhYQQ4EtiZAUI1nqI5F8V8OBz8X4ChS1iBm2Kr_l15cb5qnRuOa2fhHb1wP3OGqpK5rPx0oGiqTYph6ONBKmu68j_YTIIUDbpzFw2kw8THjSFvLyAv1sfvULMY05SfGfyh8c2pOi74M8jauRriF3Abv6YmO-ptZmzZ9sHuEzmXHI6wyuBwzkPNxBDGbrtCnL3SsB1SUaj5WxMVs0LSWz0LF-RTs1WwnN)
Thank you for your help.
Sincerely,Daniel Cameron

We're kicking off canvassing in the Fairfax / Melrose and Westchester areas this weekend, and we need your help to make it help.

| | | | | [|

| | Hi Peter!
Want to get your steps in this weekend while hanging with good people and helping an important cause? Then you’re in luck, as **we’re kicking-off canvassing this weekend!**
The election is in just over a month, and while recent polling shows that voters are with us when they learn about my continued vision for the district, many of them are unaware of the upcoming election and the stakes.
We will be working to change that this weekend by knocking doors on Saturday and Sunday, 10 AM to 2 PM. Saturday’s canvass will be in the **Fairfax/Melrose Area** and Sunday we’ll be in **Westchester**. Training will be provided, so just bring a fully charged phone, a water bottle, and comfortable walking shoes.
You can sign up to canvass on Saturday in Fairfax/Melrose [here.](https://us.list-manage.com/NbHwc7P7GGT?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
You can sign up to canvass on Sunday in Westchester [here.](https://us.list-manage.com/fDfQfWJbJ9f?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
More volunteer opportunities will be coming every week until the election, including phone banking and text banking. You can stay updated on all upcoming events [here.](https://us.list-manage.com/ZmWCyvrpf0L?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
Thank you for your support. We look forward to seeing you out there!

body:
| | | Fellow democracy defenders, In March, Donald Trump signed **an executive order aimed at taking control of Colorado’s elections away from Coloradans.** It would mean:
* Federal agencies digging into voter data.
* New barriers between eligible voters and the ballot box.
* Attacks on vote-by-mail.
* And threats to cut funding if states don’t comply.

It’s as serious as it sounds. It’s voter suppression and federal overreach **and I won’t stand for it.**
#### This week, I joined the legal fight to block this order—signing on to an amicus brief alongside election officials from 19 states who run elections and understand exactly what’s at stake.
Trump doesn’t like how we run elections in Colorado now. That’s because our system is secure, accessible, and he can’t cheat here. Imagine how he’ll feel when the next Secretary of State is a queer Latina election lawyer who’s already been fighting—and winning—these battles. | | Friend, We continue to monitor the difficult situation unfolding in South Georgia with the ongoing wildfires. Our hearts are with the families across South Georgia facing these fires. Joan and I are continuing to pray for every family affected. _**My thoughts and prayers are with you every single moment. We are also praying hard for rain across South Georgia to help ease this severe drought and bring relief to the brave men and women battling these fires.**_ I am especially moved by the courage of our firefighters, forestry crews, law enforcement officers, and all first responders who risk everything, day and night, to protect lives, homes, and the land we love. **Their bravery and selflessness in the face of these flames is truly humbling.** We have a solemn responsibility to ensure these communities have every bit of support they need and that the men and women on the front lines have the resources they need to do their vital work safely and effectively. If your community needs help in any way – _whether it’s resources, information we can help elevate, or simply someone to listen_ – please reach out to my office right away. We are here for you. _My team and I want to do everything we can to support you during this difficult time._ To the people of South Georgia: You are in my prayers, and you will remain in my thoughts long after the smoke clears. Thank you to every hero working on the ground right now. Your strength and sacrifice are greatly appreciated. With gratitude, Chris CarrGA Attorney GeneralRepublican Candidate for GA Governor

Peter, this is **HUGE.** For the first time in at least 30 years, **Democrats have qualified candidates in 204 state legislative races** — contesting 88% of the State House and 82% of the State Senate. Democrats haven’t competed on this scale since last century. It’s the clearest signal yet: **Georgians are done with Republican failures.** They’re demanding change on healthcare, education, and wages — and they’re stepping up to make it happen. This is our blueprint for November, Peter. By contesting seats Republicans thought were safely theirs, we can chip away at their entrenched majority, flip chambers, **and finally put working families first across Georgia.** But a map this big doesn’t fund itself. body:

But we also have a better option, one I know leads to victory.

clean_body: God’s children are not for sale—help us prove it She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. Her name is Alice. And this is the part most people never hear. She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's IP address. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. Alive. Her trafficker now faces 20 years to life in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking. This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting. Still trapped. And that is why the Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is clear: To stop the sale of God 's children. The foundation extends the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: A world where every child is safe and free. We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching Operation Search and Rescue, a mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence. We will support real rescue operations using tools like digital tracking and face recognition. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped. And today, you can be part of it. And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.A concerned Child Defense Organization has approved a $10,000 MATCHING GRANT. Every dollar you give will be doubled. $25 Gift Doubles to $50 $50 Gift Doubles to $100 $100 Gift Doubles to $200 $250 Gift Doubles to $500 $500 Gift Doubles to $1,000 Your gift goes twice as far to help find and rescue children. This is God multiplying love. Jesus said, " Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me." (Matthew 18:5) Today you can be that welcome. You can enable the search and help the rescue mission to bring a child home. Please give as generously as you can while your gift is matched. And please pray for Alice, and for the children still waiting. And for the day when every child is safe and free. Because God 's children are not for sale. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
